blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-based autonomous navigation for low-cost robots remains a fundamental challenge, primarily due to the significant gap between simulated training environments and real-world operational conditions. Direct policy transfer from simulation is often ineffective, while training exclusively on real data is impractical. We propose a hybrid transfer learning framework that effectively bridges the sim-to-real gap by combining domain randomization with feature-level domain adaptation. Our method employs a dual convolutional variational autoencoder architecture with a shared decoder, trained on an extensive set of 45225 simulated images and a minimal set of only 4556 real-world samples. This architecture learns a compact, common latent representation space that aligns the distributions of both domains. The adaptation process is further enhanced by two complementary data augmentation techniques designed to expand the limited real-world data. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that our method achieves an average success rate of almost 91% on image classification tasks for real-world indoor navigation, significantly outperforming both simulation-only and real-world-only training. We validate these findings through a direct, real-world deployment, where the proposed policy successfully guides a low-cost robot in a reactive exploration task. Furthermore, we validate the model’s efficiency through a rigorous computational estimation, confirming its suitability for resource-constrained embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4 and NVIDIA Jetson Nano. This work presents a practical solution for developing effective and efficient navigation policies for low-cost robotic systems.
blocks.zh: 以愿景为基础的低成本机器人自主导航仍然是一个根本性的挑战,这主要是因为模拟训练环境与现实世界操作条件之间存在巨大差距. 从模拟中直接转移政策往往没有效果,而仅仅就真实数据进行培训是不切实际的。 我们提出一个混合转移学习框架,通过将域随机化与地物级域适应性相结合,有效地弥合了模拟-现实差距. 我们的方法采用了一种双旋变异自编码器结构,它有一个共享的解码器,训练有45225个模拟图像的广泛集,只有4556个真实世界样本的最低集. 这一架构学习了一种紧凑、共同的潜在代表空间,使这两个领域的分布一致。 两种补充数据增强技术进一步加强了适应进程,这些技术旨在扩大有限的现实世界数据。 实验评价显示,我们的方法在真实世界室内导航图像分类任务上取得了近91%的平均成功率,显著地优于模拟和真实世界的训练。 我们通过直接的、现实世界的部署来验证这些结果,其中拟议的政策成功地指导了一个低成本的机器人执行被动的探索任务。 此外,我们通过严格的计算估算来验证该模型的效率,确认其是否适合使用资源受限的嵌入式平台,如Raspberry Pi 4和NVIDIA Jetson Nano等。 这项工作为制定低成本机器人系统的有效和高效导航政策提供了一个切实可行的解决办法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deep Learning (DL) [ 1 ] has achieved remarkable success in solving a diverse array of complex tasks, particularly within vision-based applications for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and robotics. These applications span from object detection and classification [ 2 , 3 , 4 ], fine-grained recognition [ 5 ], and human pose estimation [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] to embodied autonomous navigation [ 9 , 10 ]. Across many of these fields, it is common practice to learn policies within simulated environments and subsequently transfer them to real-world platforms.
blocks.zh: 深度学习(DL)[1]在解决多种多样的复杂任务方面取得了显著成功,特别是在基于视觉的人工智能(AI)和机器人应用中. 这些应用范围从物体探测和分类[2、3、4]、精细识别[5]和人造估计[6、7、8]到体现自主导航[9、10]。 在许多这些领域,通常的做法是在模拟环境中学习政策,然后将其转移到现实世界的平台。

blocks.en: As highlighted in [ 11 ], image-based learning in simulated environments offers a more straightforward training methodology compared to direct learning in reality. Physics simulators facilitate the rapid and cost-effective collection of large-scale, labeled data. In contrast, gathering extensive and properly annotated datasets in the real world can be a time-consuming, expensive, and logistically challenging endeavor.
blocks.zh: 正如[11]所强调,在模拟环境中基于图像的学习比在现实中直接学习更直接的培训方法。 物理模拟器有利于快速和高成本效益地收集大规模、有标签的数据。 相反,在现实世界中收集大量且有适当注释的数据集可能是一项耗时、昂贵和后勤挑战性的工作。

blocks.en: However, the literature has also demonstrated that policies trained exclusively on simulation data often fail to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios [ 12 , 11 ]. These difficulties primarily arise from systematic discrepancies between real and simulated environments. In the broader context of visual perception, recent studies have emphasized the critical need for robustness against real-world disturbances, such as handling occlusions [ 13 ], suppressing background noise and information inequality [ 14 ], and defending against adversarial perturbations [ 15 ]. Similarly, in the scientific literature, the discrepancies specifically between simulation and reality are commonly referred to by the term Reality Gap (RG) [ 16 , 17 ].
blocks.zh: 然而,文献还表明,专门接受模拟数据培训的政策往往无法有效地概括到现实世界的情况[12、11]。 这些困难主要出自真实环境和模拟环境之间的系统差异. 在视觉感知的更广泛背景下,最近的研究强调,迫切需要对现实世界的扰动采取有力措施,如处理堵塞行为[13],压制背景噪音和信息不平等[14],并防御对抗性的扰动[15]。 同样地,在科学文献中,模拟与现实之间的特有差异被"现实差距"(Reality Gap (RG) [16,17])一词所通称.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, two principal sets of Transfer Learning (TL) methods have emerged: Domain Randomization (DR) [ 18 ] and Domain Adaptation (DA) [ 19 ], which can be effectively combined. Furthermore, as recently affirmed by researchers such as Azzam et al. [ 20 ], it is also possible to effectively transfer policies from simulation to reality without employing the aforementioned explicit TL approaches, instead utilizing so-called Zero-Shot Generalization (ZSG) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) [ 21 ].
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,出现了两套主要的转移学习方法:域随机化(DR)[18]和域适应(DA)[19],两者可以有效结合. 此外,正如Azzam等人[20]等研究人员最近所申明的那样,如果不采用上述明确的TL方法,而是利用所谓的零热通化和加强学习[21],也可以有效地将政策从模拟转移到现实。

blocks.en: Considering the DR and DA transfer learning approaches, which are the focus of the present work, we investigate three core hypotheses:
blocks.zh: 考虑到DR和DA转移学习方法是目前工作的重点,我们调查了三种核心假设:

blocks.en: 1. A DL model trained exclusively on real-world data will struggle to perform satisfactorily across novel scenarios in a real environment without an extensive, balanced training set of labeled real-world data. 2. A DL model trained entirely on a large, balanced set of labeled simulation data will learn a policy with limited generalization capability to various scenarios in an equivalent real environment. 3. By generating a common representation space where distributions of both extensive simulation data and limited real-world data can converge, it will be possible to mitigate the discrepancies between simulated and real environments, thereby learning a policy with improved generalization accuracy in the real world.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 专门接受关于现实世界数据培训的DL模型将努力在现实环境中以令人满意的方式在各种新情况中发挥作用,而没有一套广泛、平衡的贴有标签的现实世界数据培训。 2. 完全通过一套大而平衡的标签模拟数据培训的DL模型将学习一种政策,在同等真实环境中,对各种情景的概括性能力有限。 3. 通过产生一个共同的表示空间,使广泛的模拟数据和有限的现实世界数据的分布能够趋同,将有可能减少模拟环境与现实环境之间的差异,从而学习一项在现实世界中提高通俗化精度的政策。

blocks.en: This paper proposes a deep TL method for efficiently producing policies that can generalize and adapt to diverse situations in vision-based tasks within real environments. We focus particularly on real-time tasks requiring accurate and efficient image classification [ 22 ], such as visual navigation applications involving autonomous robots in the real world.
blocks.zh: 本文件提出了一种深层的TL方法,以高效地制定政策,在现实环境中基于愿景的任务中,能够概括并适应各种情况。 我们尤其注重需要准确高效图像分类的实时任务[22],例如视觉导航应用涉及现实世界的自主机器人.

blocks.en: Specifically, our method constructs abstract low-dimensional representations from both simulation and real-world data using deep generative models. These models extract and learn meaningful features from synthetic and real images while simultaneously reducing their dimensionality. Our goal is to develop models capable of obtaining policies that can rapidly and efficiently solve various autonomous low-cost robot navigation tasks after training primarily in simulation and transferring to reality.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们的方法利用深层基因模型,从模拟和现实世界数据中构建出抽象的低维表示. 这些模型从合成和真实图像中提取并学习出有意义的特征,同时降低其维度. 我们的目标是开发能够获取能够快速高效地解决各种自主低成本机器人导航任务的政策的模型,这些任务主要是在模拟和向现实转移方面的培训后完成.

blocks.en: Our major contributions include:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献包括:

blocks.en: 1. The implementation of domain randomization by training our network with meaningful features extracted from extensive simulation data before policy transfer to reality. We collect synthetic training images using a single low-cost mobile robot in a realistic indoor environment modeled with a high-fidelity physics simulator. 2. The application of domain adaptation using two convolutional Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) [ 23 ] that share a common decoder. This decoder generates similar synthetic and pseudo-synthetic image data without requiring a direct, one-to-one correspondence between the simulated and real-world training samples, enabling successful policy generalization to novel real scenarios. 3. The creation of memory-efficient image representations, making our learned policies suitable for transfer to low-cost physical robots. This is particularly relevant for autonomous reactive navigation [ 24 , 25 ] applications that use a mobile robot equipped with a single cost-effective camera. 4. The validation of the developed method by transferring the proposed policy to a low-cost physical robot and executing a real-time, collision-free, map-less [ 26 , 27 ] visual exploration task in a real-world indoor corridor.

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows: Section 2 reviews related work on transfer learning and its main approaches, as well as specific studies on autonomous robot navigation applications in the real world. Section 3 details our proposed transfer learning method, including data acquisition, training methodology, and data augmentation techniques. Section 4 presents and analyzes our experimental results, including a proof-of-concept validation performed in the real world using a mobile robot with limited computational resources. Finally, Section 5 addresses our conclusions and directions for future research.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分如下: 第二节回顾了有关转移学习及其主要方法的相关工作,以及对现实世界自主机器人导航应用的具体研究. 第3节详细介绍了我们提议的转让学习方法,包括数据采集、培训方法和数据扩增技术。 第4节介绍和分析我们的实验结果,包括在现实世界使用有限的计算资源的移动机器人进行概念验证。 最后,第5节阐述了我们的结论和今后研究的方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: To situate our proposed hybrid TL framework, this section provides a concise overview of the prevailing strategies for bridging the simulation-to-reality gap in robotics. We first review foundational research in the two principal families of transfer learning that our method combines: domain randomization and domain adaptation. Subsequently, we examine an alternative paradigm, zero-shot generalization, to provide a comprehensive theoretical context. Finally, we survey pertinent applications in real-world robotic navigation that share objectives with our study, thereby contextualizing our approach for achieving efficient sim-to-real transfer on resource-constrained platforms.
blocks.zh: 为了安排我们提议的混合TL框架,本节简要地概述了缩小机器人模拟与真实差距的现行战略。 我们首先审查我们的方法结合的对转移学习两大家族的基础研究:域随机化和域适应. 随后,我们研究了另一种范式,即零发通论,以提供一个全面的理论背景. 最后,我们调查现实世界机器人导航中与我们的研究有共同目标的相关应用,从而将我们在资源受限的平台上实现高效的模拟到实际转移的方法结合到实际。

blocks.en: 2.1 Domain Randomization
blocks.zh: 2.1 域随机化

blocks.en: Domain randomization encompasses methods used to train more generalizable models in a source domain ( e.g. , a simulated environment) for effective prediction across systematically different target domains ( e.g. , distinct real-world environments) [ 28 ]. During training, various configurations are randomized in simulation, including object placement, illumination conditions, and surface textures.
blocks.zh: 域随机化包括用于在源域(例如模拟环境)中训练更通俗的模型的方法,以在系统不同的目标域(例如独特的现实世界环境)中进行有效的预测[28]. 在训练期间,各种配置在模拟中随机进行,包括物体放置,发光条件,和表面纹理等.

blocks.en: Domain randomization has emerged as a pivotal strategy for mitigating the reality gap, functioning as a regularization technique that prevents a DL model from overfitting to individual simulation instances [ 18 ]. The underlying hypothesis is that if the variability in simulation is sufficiently extensive, the learned policy will become robust enough to be transferred directly to a physical robot without requiring any real-world data for fine-tuning [ 29 ].
blocks.zh: 域随机化已成为缓解现实差距的关键策略,起到规范化技术的作用,防止DL模型过于适合单个模拟实例[18]. 基本假设是,如果模拟中的可变性足够广泛,所学出的政策将变得足够有力,可以直接转移到物理机器人上而不需要任何现实世界的数据来进行微调[29].

blocks.en: Two seminal works were instrumental in establishing this TL approach in robotics. In 2017, Sadeghi and Levine [ 28 ] leveraged domain randomization for real-world navigation tasks. Their method generated a collision avoidance policy using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) [ 30 ] trained through deep reinforcement learning. Their model processed raw Red, Green, Blue (RGB) camera images to predict collision probability, enabling velocity command determination for collision-free indoor flight of a physical quadrotor.

blocks.en: Unlike our TL approach, which incorporates real-world data, their navigation policy relied entirely on synthetic training image data from a simulated environment. Their method did not require particularly high-fidelity simulation or extreme realism. Instead, Sadeghi and Levine extensively randomized rendering settings for their synthetic dataset, forcing the network to handle diverse obstacle appearances and lighting conditions. This approach made their learned high-dimensional representations invariant to surface appearance, enabling the model to learn geometric features for robust open space detection across different real indoor environments. The initial training phase of our proposed method is fundamentally rooted in this principle of procedural randomization.
blocks.zh: 我们的TL方法包含了现实世界的数据,与此不同,他们的导航政策完全依赖于模拟环境中的合成训练图像数据. 他们的方法不需要特别高的真伪模拟或极端现实主义. 取而代之的是,萨德吉和莱文对其合成数据集广泛随机渲染设置,迫使网络处理各种障碍外观和照明条件. 这种方法使得他们所学的高维表现力与表面外观不相适应,使模型能够学习几何特征,以便在不同的真实室内环境中进行强烈的开放空间探测. 我们拟议方法的初步培训阶段从根本上植根于这一程序随机化原则。

blocks.en: Concurrently, Tobin et al. [ 29 ] popularized domain randomization for robotic manipulation tasks. One year later, in [ 31 ], they proposed a novel deep generative architecture for learning grasp sampling distributions across diverse objects. Their network was trained exclusively on unrealistic procedurally generated objects from physics simulation. The architecture developed by Tobin et al. employed an autoregressive model [ 23 ] that processed embedding representations mapped from target object observations through an image representation module. The model generated distributions over possible grasps using additional depth images captured by a simulated robot’s hand camera. The architecture aimed to select optimal grasps from the sampled possibilities. Their network achieved 92% success rate on unseen realistic objects during simulation testing and 80% success rate on real-world grasp attempts.
blocks.zh: 同时,托宾等. [29] 为机器人操纵任务普及域随机化. 一年后,在[31]中,他们提出了一种新的深层基因结构来学习掌握不同物体之间的采样分布. 他们的网络专门接受物理模拟程序产生的不切实际物体的培训。 Tobin等开发的架构采用了自旋式模型[23],通过图像表示模块处理从目标物体观测所绘制的嵌入表示. 该模型利用模拟机器人手相机所摄取的更多深度图像,通过可能的抓取产生分布. 该架构旨在从抽样可能性中选择最佳把握。 他们的网络在模拟测试中取得了92%的隐形现实物体的成功率,在现实世界的捕捉尝试中取得了80%的成功率.

blocks.en: Like our DR method, the previous works are based on the so-called static domain randomization, which typically relies on uniform sampling from a fixed domain parameter distribution. This particular approach usually implements sim-to-real transfer using any real-world data. Although it represents a technique that can effectively, quickly, and relatively easily bridge the reality gap, learned policies tend to perform worse in the target domain than those produced adaptively. [ 18 ].
blocks.zh: 和我们的DR方法一样,前作基于所谓的静态域随机化,这通常依赖于从固定域参数分布中统一取样. 这种特殊的方法通常使用任何现实世界的数据进行sim-to-real的传输. 虽然它是一种能够有效、迅速和相对容易地弥合现实差距的技术,但学到的知识政策在目标领域的表现往往比适应性地产生的政策更糟。 [18].

blocks.en: Adaptive domain randomization employs different strategies that refine the simulation distribution during the learning process, introducing efficiency and higher fidelity by closing the sim-to-real loop. On the one hand, curriculum-based approaches, such as automatic domain randomization, seeks to increase the sample efficiency by introducing a schedule of increasing difficulty [ 18 ]. On the other hand, active domain randomization aims to improve training efficiency by actively searching for the most informative or challenging simulation parameters for the current policy, thereby focusing computational effort on those hard cases that are most likely to improve robustness [ 32 ].
blocks.zh: 适应性域随机化采用不同的策略来完善学习过程中的模拟分布,通过关闭sim-to-real循环引入效率和更高的忠诚度. 一方面,基于课程的方法,如自动域随机化,试图通过引入一个增加难度的时间表来提高样本效率[18]. 另一方面,主动域随机化旨在通过积极为当前政策寻找信息最丰富或最具挑战性的模拟参数来提高培训效率,从而将计算努力的重点放在最有可能提高稳健性的硬性案例上[32].

blocks.en: The most advanced methods belonging to adaptive domain randomization close the sim-to-real loop by using data from the real world to directly guide the simulation process. This represents a fundamental conceptual shift from generalization to adaptation. A notable example is the task-driven framework called AdaptSim, proposed by Ren et al. [ 33 ]. They meta-learned an adaptation policy through reinforcement learning using a simulator to adjust the simulation parameter distribution based on its performance on the target task. Subsequently, the policy was deployed in the real world, utilizing a few interactions to find the optimal simulation configuration for re-training.
blocks.zh: 属于适应性域随机化的最先进方法通过使用来自现实世界的数据来直接指导模拟过程来关闭sim-to-real循环. 这是一种从一般化到适应的根本概念转变。 一个显著的例子是Ren等人提出的名为AdaptSim的任务驱动框架。 [33]. 他们通过使用模拟器进行强化学习,根据模拟参数在目标任务上的性能来调整模拟参数分布,从而获得适应政策。 随后,该政策被部署在现实世界,利用一些互动来寻找再培训的最佳模拟配置.

blocks.en: Our proposed approach offers a compelling and practical alternative to online, simulator-centric adaptation schemes. Instead of adapting the simulator to match reality, our method adapts the model’s perception of reality by fine-tuning a pre-trained variational autoencoder using a small batch of real data. This model-centric adaptation strategy is offline and highly data-efficient, making it particularly suitable for low-cost platforms where continuous real-world interaction for iterative simulator tuning is impractical or unsafe.
blocks.zh: 我们提议的办法为在线、模拟-以适应计划提供了令人信服的实际替代办法。 我们的方法不是调整模拟器以适应现实,而是调整模型对现实的认识,利用一小批真实数据,微调一个预先训练的可变自编码器。 这种以模型为核心的适应战略是离线的并具有很高的数据效率的,使它特别适合低成本的平台,在这些平台中,用于迭代模拟器调制的持续现实世界互动是不切实际的或不安全的.

blocks.en: 2.2 Domain Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.2 领域适应

blocks.en: Whereas domain randomization operates exclusively on the source domain ( e.g. , a simulated environment) to foster generalization, domain adaptation is a transfer learning paradigm that actively leverages data from the target domain ( e.g. , a real-world environment) to align the distributions between the source and target environments [ 19 ].
blocks.zh: 而域随机化则完全在源域上运行(如:模拟环境)来培育通俗化,而域相适应则是一种转移学习范式,能积极从目标域(如:现实世界环境)调取数据来使源域与目标环境之间的分布一致[19].

blocks.en: Contemporary DA techniques for sim-to-real transfer can be broadly categorized into two main families: pixel-level adaptation, which modifies the visual appearance of source images, and feature-level adaptation, which aligns the underlying representations learned by the model [ 19 ]. Our proposed method employs generative feature-level domain adaptation to fine-tune a robust model initially pre-trained with domain randomization.
blocks.zh: 当代DA对sim-to-real transfer的技术可以大致分为两大类:像素级适应,它修改了源图像的视觉外观;和地物级适应,它协调了模型所学到的基本表述[19]. 我们提议的方法采用基因特征级域调整,以微调最初经过域随机化培训的强健模型。

blocks.en: Pixel-level adaptation methods aim to bridge the reality gap by translating synthetic source images to appear as if they were drawn from the target domain’s distribution. This is predominantly achieved using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) [ 23 ], particularly through unpaired image-to-image translation architectures like CycleGAN [ 34 ].
blocks.zh: 像素级的适应方法旨在通过将合成源图像翻译成从目标域的分布中抽取的外观来弥补现实差距. 这主要是利用Generative Adversarial Networks(GANs)[23]实现的,特别是通过CycleGAN等未发作的图像到图像翻译架构[34].

blocks.en: However, a critical challenge with this approach is the potential for semantic inconsistency. A GAN optimized solely for visual realism may produce photo-realistic images at the expense of altering or even removing task-critical content, such as obstacles or key objects, leading to catastrophic policy failure [ 35 ]. To mitigate this, task-aware extensions have been developed. A notable example is RL-CycleGAN, proposed by Rao et al. [ 35 ], which introduces an additional reinforcement learning-based consistency loss. Our proposed method circumvents the training instability and semantic consistency issues inherent in GANs by operating at the feature level, which offers a more stable and direct approach to aligning domain-invariant structural information.
blocks.zh: 然而,这一方法面临的一个重大挑战是语义不一致的可能性。 完全为视觉现实主义而优化的GAN可能会产生相片现实主义的图像而牺牲改变甚至去掉任务关键内容,如障碍或关键对象,导致灾难性的政策失败[35]. 为缓解这种情况,已开发出认识到任务的扩展。 一个显著的例子是由Rao等人提出的RL-CycleGAN[35],它引入了额外的以强化学习为基础的一致性损失. 我们提出的方法通过在特征层面操作来规避GANs固有的培训不稳定和语义一致性问题,这为调整域-变量结构信息提供了更稳定和更直接的方法.

blocks.en: Instead of altering input images, feature-level adaptation methods seek to learn a mapping that projects both source and target data into a common, domain-invariant representation space where their distributions are aligned. Within this shared feature space, a classifier trained on labeled source data can generalize effectively to unlabeled target data [ 19 ]. These methods are primarily divided into two families: statistical and adversarial.
blocks.zh: 特征级的适应方法不是改变输入图像,而是想学习一种绘图方法,将源数据和目标数据都投射到一个共同的、域-不变量的表示空间,使分布一致。 在这个共享的特性空间内,一个接受过有标签源数据培训的分类器可以有效地被概括为无标签的目标数据[19]. 这些方法主要分为两个家族:统计和对抗.

blocks.en: Statistical methods directly minimize a distance metric between the feature distributions of the two domains. A prominent example is Deep Correlation Alignment (Deep CORAL), which introduces a CORAL loss to align the second-order statistics ( i.e. , covariances) of the source and target feature distributions within one or more layers of a deep network [ 36 ].
blocks.zh: 统计方法直接将两个域特征分布之间的距离度量最小化. 一个突出的例子是"深度关联对接"(Deep CORAL),它引入了CORAL损失来将源与目标特征分布在一个深度网络的一层或多层内对接的二阶统计(即共变)[36].

blocks.en: In contrast, adversarial methods employ a domain discriminator in a zero-sum game against the feature extractor. The discriminator is trained to distinguish the origin of the features ( i.e. , the source domain or the target domain), while the feature extractor is trained to produce features that fool the discriminator, thereby forcing the distributions to become indistinguishable [ 19 ]. A seminal work in this area is the Domain-Adversarial Neural Network (DANN), which uses a novel Gradient Reversal Layer (GRL) to enable end-to-end adversarial training [ 37 ]. These foundational methods, many of which are implemented in standard libraries like Awesome Domain Adaptation Python Toolbox 1 1 1 https://adapt-python.github.io/adapt/ (ADAPT), form the basis for modern feature-level adaptation.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,对抗性方法在对特性提取器的零和游戏中使用了域分法. 歧视者接受过区分特征起源(即源域或目标域)的训练,而特征提取器则接受过训练来制作会愚弄歧视者的特征,从而迫使分布变得不可分 [19]. 该领域的一出开创性作品是"域-异常神经网络"(DANN),它使用小说"渐变回流层"(GRL)来进行端到端的对抗训练[37]. 这些基础方法,许多方法在"真棒域"适应Python工具箱11 1等标准库被实施,https://adapt-python.github.io/adapt/(ADAPT),构成了现代地物级适应的基础.

blocks.en: Our work is situated within the domain of generative feature-level adaptation, which leverages deep generative models to learn a common latent space. The choice between a VAE and a GAN for this purpose involves a fundamental trade-off. While GANs can produce sharp, high-fidelity images, their adversarial training is notoriously unstable. VAEs, conversely, offer highly stable training and produce a continuous, structured latent space well-suited for control tasks, though their reconstructions tend to be blurry [ 23 ].
blocks.zh: 我们的工作位于基因特征层面的适应领域,利用深层基因模型学习共同的潜在空间。 为此,在VAE和GAN之间作出选择涉及根本取舍。 虽然GANs能产生尖锐,高真实度的图像,但他们的对抗训练却臭名昭著地不稳定. 反之,VAEs则提供高度稳定的训练,并产生一个持续,结构化的潜在空间,非常适合控制任务,尽管它们的重建往往模糊 [23].

blocks.en: 2.3 Zero-Shot Generalization
blocks.zh: 2.3 零热通化

blocks.en: An alternative paradigm to explicit transfer learning is zero-shot generalization, which aims to train a policy entirely in simulation that can be deployed directly in the real world without any fine-tuning or adaptation on target domain data [ 21 ]. This zero-shot sim-to-real transfer is often pursued through hybrid approaches that combine reinforcement learning with domain randomization to create a robust policy [ 38 ]. However, a distinct line of research, and the focus of this subsection, investigates the feasibility of achieving ZSG by relying exclusively on RL, foregoing explicit DR or domain adaptation.
blocks.zh: 明确转让学习的另一种范式是零发通化,其目的是在模拟中完全训练一种政策,这种政策可以直接部署在现实世界,而不对目标域数据进行任何微调或调整[21]. 这种零发相的sim-to- real transfer常常通过混合方法来进行,将强化学习与域随机化相结合,从而形成一个强有力的政策[38]. 然而,一行不同的研究,以及本分节的重点,通过完全依靠RL(高于明确的DR或域调整)来调查实现ZSG的可行性.

blocks.en: One prominent strategy for RL-only ZSG is to invest in creating a high-fidelity digital twin of the physical system. The underlying hypothesis is that if the simulator’s dynamics are sufficiently accurate, the reality gap becomes negligible, allowing a standard RL policy to transfer directly. A compelling demonstration of this approach is presented by Azzam et al. [ 20 ], who developed a navigation and collision avoidance policy for an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). Their framework employs a hierarchical control structure where the RL agent learns high-level velocity commands, which are then executed by a low-level controller.
blocks.zh: 仅RL-ZSG的一个突出策略是投资创建物理系统的高可靠性数字双子. 基本假设是,如果模拟器的动态足够准确,则现实差距会变得可以忽略不计,允许标准RL政策直接转移. Azzam等人提出了这一方法的令人信服的证明,他为无人驾驶飞行器制定了航行和避免碰撞的政策。 他们的框架采用分级控制结构,RL代理学习高层次速度命令,然后由低层次控制器执行.

blocks.en: The key to their success in achieving direct sim-to-real transfer without any randomization was the meticulous system identification of the UAV’s dynamic model using a deep neural network-based method. By ensuring the simulated dynamics closely mirrored reality, the policy learned by Azzam et al. achieved a 90% success rate in real-world experiments. This result is remarkably comparable to the 90.88% classification accuracy achieved by our proposed method on our real-world test dataset.
blocks.zh: 他们成功实现不作任何随机的直线到实线传输的关键是使用深层神经网络方法对无人机的动态模型进行细致的系统识别. 通过确保模拟动态紧密地反映现实,Azzam等人所学出的政策在现实世界实验中取得了90%的成功率. 这一结果与我们提议的在现实世界测试数据集上达到的90.88%的分类精度相当。

blocks.en: Counter-intuitively, an alternative approach posits that lower, rather than higher, simulation fidelity can lead to superior sim-to-real transfer. This hypothesis, explored by Truong et al. [ 10 ], argues that high-fidelity physics simulations can be computationally slow and may cause the policy to overfit to simulator-specific inaccuracies that do not exist in the real world. Their solution is to strategically abstract away the complex dynamics. Truong et al. propose a hierarchical decomposition where a high-level navigation policy is trained with RL in a fast, low-fidelity kinematic simulation. This policy learns to output desired velocity commands, which are then passed to the robot’s native, potentially black-box, low-level controller for execution in the real world.
blocks.zh: 反直觉上,一种替代方法假设模拟忠诚度较低而不是更高,可导致优异的sim-to-real转移。 这个假设,由特鲁翁等探讨. [10],认为高真实度物理模拟在计算上可能很慢,并可能导致政策过于适合模拟特定不准确,而真实世界中并不存在. 它们的解决办法是从战略上抽象地消除复杂的动态。 特鲁翁等. 提出分级分解,其中高水平导航政策在快速,低真实性动能模拟中与RL一起训练. 这个政策学习输出所期望的速度命令,然后传递给机器人的原生,潜在的黑盒,低级控制器,以便在现实世界执行.

blocks.en: The approaches reviewed above highlight a fundamental trade-off in sim-to-real transfer. End-to-end RL systems for ZSG are predicated on minimizing the reality gap a priori , either by investing in robot-specific system identification [ 20 ] or by abstracting away complex dynamics [ 10 ]. Both strategies can be brittle. The former is sensitive to any unmodeled dynamics or changes in the physical robot over time, while the latter is limited by the expressive capacity of the abstracted action space [ 10 ].
blocks.zh: 上文所审查的办法突出了在实际转让方面的根本取舍。 ZSG的端到端RL系统基于先验的将现实差距最小化,要么投资机器人特定系统识别[20],要么抽象出复杂的动态[10]. 这两种战略都可能不灵活。 前者对随时间推移而在物理机器人中出现的任何未建模动态或变化都很敏感,而后者则受抽象动作空间的表达能力所限制[10].

blocks.en: In contrast, our proposed method acknowledges the inherent imperfections of any simulator. It adopts a hybrid, few-shot sim-to-real strategy that is more robust and flexible. By first leveraging domain randomization, it learns a generalized feature representation that is not overfitted to a single simulation instance. Subsequently, it performs a highly efficient, model-centric adaptation by fine-tuning a pre-trained variational autoencoder using a small batch of unlabeled real images.
blocks.zh: 相反,我们提议的方法承认任何模拟器的固有缺陷。 它采用了一种混合的、少有射入的、更加有力和灵活的战略。 通过首先利用域随机化,它学习了一个不与单一模拟实例相过于相适应的通用特征表现. 之后,它通过使用一小批无标签真实图像来微调预训变异自编码器,来进行高度高效,以模型为中心的改造.

blocks.en: A third and rapidly emerging pathway to generalization in robotics is through the use of large-scale, pre-trained foundation models. Models such as RT-2 [ 39 ] derive their remarkable generalization capabilities not from mastering simulation physics, but from being pre-trained on vast, internet-scale datasets of real-world images and text. This allows them to acquire a broad semantic understanding of objects, concepts, and actions, enabling impressive zero-shot and few-shot performance on a wide range of manipulation and navigation tasks. However, this approach introduces a critical trade-off. While foundation models excel at open-vocabulary reasoning, they are computationally massive, with memory and processing requirements that are prohibitive for the low-cost, resource-constrained robotic platforms [ 39 ] that are the focus of our research.
blocks.zh: 机器人领域实现通化的第三个快速途径是使用大规模、预先培训的基础模型。 RT-2[39]等模型的出自其显著的通俗化能力,不是从掌握模拟物理,而是从对现实世界图像和文本的庞大的互联网规模数据集进行预训. 这使得他们能够获得对物体,概念和行动的广泛语义理解,使得在广泛的操控和导航任务上能够令人印象深刻的零发和少发性能. 然而,这种办法提出了关键的取舍。 虽然基础模型在开放-伏尔布利推理方面非常出色,但它们在计算上是庞大的,对作为我们研究重点的低成本、资源受限的机器人平台来说,内存和处理要求是令人望而却步的。

blocks.en: 2.4 Real-World Autonomous Navigation Systems
blocks.zh: 2.4 真实世界自主导航系统

blocks.en: Recent research in autonomous navigation has yielded a diverse array of specialized solutions, each tailored to specific application domains and operational constraints. In the automotive sector, studies range from the development of robust fuzzy logic controllers for enhancing electric vehicle stability and power quality [ 40 ] to the design of neural networks for the semantic segmentation of radar point clouds [ 41 ].
blocks.zh: 最近对自主导航的研究产生了各种各样的专门解决方案,每个解决方案都适合具体的应用领域和操作限制. 在汽车行业,研究范围从发展强活模糊逻辑控制器来增强电动车辆稳定性和动力质量[40]到设计雷达点云的语义分化神经网络[41].

blocks.en: Biologically-inspired methods have also gained prominence in robotics research. Aljalbout et al. [ 42 ], for instance, developed a generalizable framework using spiking neural networks to instantiate central pattern generators for legged locomotion across different robot morphologies with minimal design effort. More aligned with our focus on mobile robots, Chen et al. [ 43 ] proposed the Cuckoo-Beetle Swarm Search (CBSS) algorithm for path planning [ 24 ] in heterogeneous robot teams. Their bio-inspired optimization method developed a navigation system for obstacle avoidance in indoor environments.
blocks.zh: 生物启发的方法在机器人研究中也获得了突出地位. 例如,Aljalbout等人[42] 开发了一个通用框架,利用尖端神经网络,以最小的设计努力,在不同的机器人形态上对腿部运动的中央图案发电机进行即时处理。 更符合我们关注移动机器人,陈等. [43] 提出了Cuckoo-Beetle Swarm搜索(CBSS)算法,用于各种机器人团队的路径规划[24]. 他们的生物启发优化方法开发出一种在室内环境中避免障碍的导航系统.

blocks.en: Consistent with the methodology of this study, Chen et al. first validated their system in simulation before deploying it on real Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs). However, a key distinction lies in the sensor modality; their method relied on a Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensor [ 44 ] for environmental perception. While LiDAR provides high-precision depth information, its associated cost and weight can be prohibitive for the low-cost platforms central to our research.
blocks.zh: 根据本研究的方法,Chen等人首先在模拟中验证了他们的系统,然后将其部署在真正的无人地面车辆上。 然而,一个关键区别在于传感器模式;其方法依赖光探测和测距传感器[44]来进行环境认知。 虽然LiDAR提供了高精度的深度信息,但其相关成本和重量对于我们的研究核心的低成本平台可能令人望而却步.

blocks.en: More closely aligned with our work’s emphasis on minimalist sensing, Othman and Rad [ 45 ] presented a visual system belonging to an end-to-end navigation strategy for behavior-based robots [ 46 ], focusing on doorway detection using only monocular RGB camera input. Their approach employed a convolutional neural network to classify scenes as containing an open door or not, guiding navigation through depth estimation and obstacle detection modules. The system was validated on a NAO humanoid robot, using a single camera to demonstrate the potential of minimal sensor configurations for executing complex navigation subtasks.
blocks.zh: Othman和Rad[45]提出了一种属于行为机器人端到端导航策略的视觉系统[46], 他们的方法是使用一个演化神经网络,将场景归类为是否包含一个开口的门,通过深度估计和障碍探测模块引导导航. 该系统在NAO人造机器人上进行了验证,使用了一款相机来演示执行复杂导航子任务的最小传感器配置的潜力.

blocks.en: 3 Sim-to-Real Transfer with Dual Variational Autoencoders
blocks.zh: 3 Sim-to-Real 带有双相自动编码器

blocks.en: This section details our proposed hybrid transfer learning method, which is designed to bridge the simulation-to-reality gap for vision-based robotic navigation. Our framework integrates two principal strategies: domain randomization and domain adaptation. The core of our approach is a dual convolutional variational autoencoder architecture that shares a common decoder. This structure learns a shared latent representation space where the feature distributions of simulated and real-world images can converge.
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍了我们提出的混合转移学习方法,这种方法旨在为基于视觉的机器人导航弥补模拟-现实差距. 我们的框架融合了两个主要战略:域随机化和域适应. 我们方法的核心是双旋变异自编码器架构,共享一个共同的解码器. 这种结构可以学习一个共享的潜在的表示空间,模拟和现实世界图像的特征分布可以在此相汇合.

blocks.en: To further enhance this alignment, we employ two distinct data augmentation techniques to synthesize additional training samples from the limited real-world data, thereby improving the model’s generalization capabilities in the target domain. The following subsections describe our data acquisition protocol, the architecture for generating the shared representation space, and the data augmentation strategies used to refine it.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步加强这种配合,我们采用两种不同的数据增强技术,从有限的现实世界数据中合成更多的培训样本,从而提高该模型在目标领域的通用能力。 以下各分节描述了我们的数据获取协议、生成共享表达空间的架构以及用于完善其的数据增强战略。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Acquisition for Hybrid Sim-to-Real Transfer
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 混合Sim-to-Real 传输数据获取

blocks.en: The successful implementation of our hybrid TL method requires two distinct datasets: an extensive, labeled synthetic dataset from the source domain ( i.e. , simulation) and a small, labeled real-world dataset from the target domain ( i.e. , reality).
blocks.zh: 我们的混合TL方法的成功实施需要两个截然不同的数据集:一个来自源域(即模拟)的被标记为广泛的合成数据集,另一个来自被标记为目标域(即现实)的被标记为小的活世界数据集.

blocks.en: To generate the synthetic source dataset, we employed a custom high-fidelity physics simulator to model an indoor corridor environment, shown in Fig. 1 (a) and Fig. 1 (b), and a Makeblock mBot Ranger 2 2 2 https://www.makeblock.com/pages/mbot-ranger-robot-building-kit robot equipped with a monocular RGB camera [ 44 ].
blocks.zh: 为了生成合成源数据集,我们使用自定义的高纯度物理模拟器模拟室内走廊环境,如图1(a)和图1(b)所示,并使用Makeblock mBot Ranger 2 2 2 2 https://www.makeblock.com/pages/mbot-ranger-robot-building-kit 装有单相机RGB相机的机器人 [44].

blocks.en: This phase implements a static domain randomization strategy. During data collection, we expose the virtual robot to diverse scenarios featuring various fixed obstacles ( e.g. , walls, columns, and door frames), varying illumination conditions, and elements with realistic textures, such as the floor surface. Our robot encounters these varying conditions while performing collision-free exploration tasks using a depth sensor [ 44 ].
blocks.zh: 这一阶段实施静态域随机化策略. 在数据收集过程中,我们让虚拟机器人接触到各种不同的情况,其特点是各种固定障碍(如墙壁、柱子和门框),不同的发光条件,以及具有现实纹理的元素,如地表等。 我们的机器人在使用深度传感器执行无相撞探测任务时遇到这些不同的条件[44].

blocks.en: This process yielded a large-scale dataset of 45225 labeled synthetic images, designed to train a policy that is inherently robust to a wide range of visual appearances. Our simulator, built upon the Planck.js 3 3 3 https://piqnt.com/planck.js/ 2D physics engine, is designed to facilitate the rapid and scalable collection of labeled data for various robotic learning tasks.
blocks.zh: 这个过程产生了由45225个有标签的合成图像组成的大规模数据集,旨在训练一种从本质上对各种视觉外观具有强烈性的政策. 我们的模拟器,基于Planck.js 3 3 https://piqnt.com/planck.js/ 2D物理引擎,旨在为各种机器人学习任务提供快速和可扩展的标签数据的收集.

blocks.en: For the target domain, we used the identical physical Makeblock mBot Ranger robot to capture a significantly smaller dataset of 4556 images within the corresponding real-world indoor corridor. These real images are crucial for the domain adaptation phase, where they are used to fine-tune the model pre-trained on simulated data, as detailed in the subsequent subsections.

The architecture is intentionally kept compact to ensure that the learned policies are memory-efficient and suitable for real-time deployment on low-cost robotic platforms. As demonstrated in the literature [ 47 , 48 , 49 ], memory efficiency and processing speed are crucial for low-cost robotics due to inherent memory, processing, and power constraints.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: This section presents a comprehensive empirical evaluation of our proposed hybrid transfer learning framework, designed to validate the three core hypotheses articulated in Section 1 . We conducted a series of experiments to assess the efficacy of our approach, which synergizes domain randomization and domain adaptation to bridge the simulation-to-reality gap. The evaluation is structured around three balanced, labeled test datasets comprising real images previously unseen during training and three distinct deep neural network architectures, each designed to assess a specific learning paradigm:
blocks.zh: 本节介绍对我们提议的混合转移学习框架的全面经验评价,其目的是验证第1节所阐明的三个核心假设。 我们进行了一系列实验,以评估我们的方法的功效,这种方法将域随机化和域适应化结合起来,以弥补模拟-现实差距. 评估的结构包括三个平衡的、贴有标签的测试数据集,其中包括以前在培训期间所未见的真实图像和三个独特的深层神经网络架构,每个数据集旨在评估具体的学习范式:

blocks.en: (1) A baseline model trained and evaluated exclusively on real image data, representing a conventional real-world-only training approach. (2) A deep neural network architecture trained entirely on synthetic data via the static DR strategy detailed in Section 3 , and subsequently evaluated on real test image data to quantify the extent of the reality gap. (3) Our proposed pseudo-synthetic architecture, which is first pre-trained on the extensive simulation dataset and then fine-tuned using the limited real-world dataset via feature-level domain adaptation. The model’s alignment between domains is further enhanced through the application of the two data augmentation techniques described in Subsection 3.3 . This final architecture is also evaluated on real test image data.
blocks.zh: (1) 完全根据真实图像数据来培训和评价基线模型,代表一种常规的、仅限现实世界的培训方法。 (2) 通过第3节所详述的静态DR策略,完全接受合成数据培训的深神经网络架构,随后对真实测试图像数据进行评价,以量化现实差距的程度。 (3)我们提出的伪合成架构,首先对广泛的模拟数据集进行预训,再通过地物级域位调整,对有限的现实世界数据集进行微调. 通过应用第3.3分节所描述的两种数据增强技术,进一步加强了该模型各域之间的协调。 这一最终架构也在真实的测试图像数据上得到评价.

blocks.en: A baseline model trained and evaluated exclusively on real image data, representing a conventional real-world-only training approach.
blocks.zh: 仅根据真实图像数据培训和评价一个基线模型,代表一种常规的只有现实世界的培训方法。

blocks.en: A deep neural network architecture trained entirely on synthetic data via the static DR strategy detailed in Section 3 , and subsequently evaluated on real test image data to quantify the extent of the reality gap.
blocks.zh: 一个深神经网络架构通过第3节所详述的静态DR策略,完全接受了合成数据的训练,随后对真实测试图像数据进行了评价,以量化现实差距的程度.

blocks.en: Our proposed pseudo-synthetic architecture, which is first pre-trained on the extensive simulation dataset and then fine-tuned using the limited real-world dataset via feature-level domain adaptation. The model’s alignment between domains is further enhanced through the application of the two data augmentation techniques described in Subsection 3.3 . This final architecture is also evaluated on real test image data.
blocks.zh: 我们提出的伪合成架构,它首先对广泛的模拟数据集进行预先训练,然后通过地物级域位调整,对有限的现实世界数据集进行微调. 通过应用第3.3分节所描述的两种数据增强技术,进一步加强了该模型各域之间的协调。 这一最终架构也在真实的测试图像数据上得到评价.

blocks.en: The subsequent analysis encompasses a qualitative assessment of the generative models’ capabilities, a quantitative evaluation of the learned classification policies, and an in-depth analysis of the resulting latent representation spaces. To validate the method’s suitability for resource-constrained platforms, we include an estimation of its computational efficiency. Finally, we present a proof-of-concept case study detailing the successful deployment of the proposed policy on a low-cost physical robot performing a reactive, collision-free exploration task in a real-world environment.
blocks.zh: 随后的分析包括对基因模型的能力进行定性评估,对学到的分类政策进行定量评估,并深入分析由此产生的潜在代表空间。 为了证实该方法是否适合资源受限的平台,我们对其计算效率作了估计。 最后,我们提出一项概念证明案例研究,详细介绍关于在现实世界环境中执行被动、无相撞探索任务的低成本物理机器人拟议政策的成功部署情况。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Protocols and Architectures
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验协议和结构

blocks.en: This subsection details the specific implementation of the training and evaluation protocols for each of the three experimental paradigms. We describe the deep learning architectures employed to learn three distinct image classification policies, each applicable to vision-based robotic navigation in real-world environments.
blocks.zh: 本分节详细介绍了三个实验范式中每一个的培训和评价协议的具体执行情况. 我们描述了学习三种不同图像分类政策的深层学习结构,它们都适用于现实世界环境中基于视觉的机器人导航。

blocks.en: In Experiment (1), which serves as a real-world baseline, a convolutional VAE was trained using unsupervised learning [ 52 ] exclusively on the 4556 real-world images. This model’s primary function was to perform unsupervised feature extraction, generating abstract, low-dimensional representations from a small, labeled subset of 186 real images, previously preprocessed to 64x64 RGB format. These compact 32-element latent vectors subsequently served as input for training a lightweight Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) [ 53 ] via supervised learning [ 52 ]. The classifier’s simple architecture, comprising a single hidden layer of 100 neurons and an output layer of 4 neurons, was intentionally designed for memory efficiency. Given the inherent challenges of acquiring a large and balanced labeled dataset from reality, we employed a stratified 10-fold cross-validation [ 54 ] methodology to ensure a robust and reliable evaluation of the resulting policy.
blocks.zh: 在作为现实世界基线的实验(1)中,一个进取的VAE接受了专门使用4556个现实世界图像的无监督学习[52]的培训. 这个模型的主要功能是进行不受监督的特征提取,从一个有186个真实图像的被标记的小子集产生抽象的低维表示,之前被预处理到64x64的RGB格式. 这些紧凑的32-元素潜在向量随后成为通过监督学习[52]培训轻量级多激光传感器[53]的投入。 分类器的简单架构由100个神经元的单层隐藏层和4个神经元的输出层组成,是为内存效率而有意设计的. 鉴于从现实中获得一个大而平衡的标签数据集的固有挑战,我们采用了分级的10倍交叉验证[54]方法,以确保对由此产生的政策进行有力而可靠的评价。

blocks.en: For Experiment (2), representing a pure domain randomization methodology, a convolutional VAE was trained with unsupervised learning on the large-scale dataset of 45225 synthetic images. This process, which implements our procedural randomization strategy by exposing the model to a wide variety of simulated conditions, aimed to learn a policy with a high degree of generalization. The VAE’s encoder generated low-dimensional representations from the synthetic data, which were then used to train a supervised classification network with a structure identical to that of the baseline experiment. This synthetic architecture was subsequently evaluated on real test scenarios to quantitatively assess the performance of a direct sim-to-real policy transfer without any adaptation to the target domain.
blocks.zh: 对于实验(2)来说,代表一种纯域随机化方法,一个演化的VAE接受了关于45225合成图像的大规模数据集的无监督学习培训. 这个过程通过将模型暴露在各种各样的模拟条件下来执行我们的程序随机化策略,旨在学习一个高度概括的政策. VAE的编码器从合成数据中生成了低维的表示,然后用于训练一个与基线实验结构相同的有监督的分类网络. 这一合成结构随后在真实的测试情景上进行了评价,以在数量上评估直接的从模拟到实际的政策转移的性能,而无需对目标领域作出任何调整。

blocks.en: In Experiment (3), our proposed hybrid transfer learning method was evaluated. Its core is a dual VAE architecture employing a shared decoder, a structure inspired by the work of Inoue et al. [ 11 ]. However, our method significantly advances this concept by applying it to a much larger and more challenging dataset: 45225 synthetic and 4556 real images, compared to 4131 synthetic and only 54 paired real images in their work. Additionally, our TL method integrates two complementary data augmentation techniques to further enhance domain alignment. This scaled-up approach facilitates a more robust alignment of the latent space, enabling the high performance reported in our findings.
blocks.zh: 在"实验"(3)中,评价了我们提议的混合转移学习方法. 其核心是使用共享解码器的双相VAE架构,由Inoue等作品所启发的结构. [11]. 然而,我们的方法通过将它应用到一个更大和更具挑战性的数据集来大大地推进了这一概念:45225个合成和4556个真实图像,相比之下,431个合成和只有54个成对的真实图像在他们的作品中. 此外,我们的TL方法融合了两种互补数据增强技术,以进一步加强域协调. 这一扩大办法有助于更有力地调整潜在空间,从而使我们能够在调查结果中报告高绩效。

blocks.en: The process begins by taking the pre-trained variational autoencoder from the DR stage ( i.e. , Experiment (2)). We then perform domain adaptation by fine-tuning its encoder using the 4556 unlabeled real-world images, while the parameters of the shared decoder remain frozen. To augment the limited real-world data and improve the robustness of this adaptation, we first generated an expanded balanced set of 34600 samples through standard image-space transformations ( e.g. , cropping, brightness, contrast, and saturation adjustments). Secondly, we synthesized 18500 novel samples by systematically perturbing the latent space representations of the real-world images. This was achieved by slightly modifying the values of only 2 random elements out of the 32 that constituted each latent vector.
blocks.zh: 该过程从DR阶段取出被预先训练的变异自编码器(即实验(2))开始. 然后,我们通过使用4556个无标签真实世界图像对编码器进行微调来进行域名调整,而共享解码器的参数仍然被冻结. 为了增加有限的现实世界数据并改进这种适应的稳健性,我们首先通过标准图像-空间转换(如裁剪、亮度、对比和饱和度调整),产生了一套扩大的平衡的34600个样本。 第二,我们通过系统地扰动现实世界图像的潜在空间表现,合成了18500个小说样本。 这是通过略微修改构成每个潜在矢量的32个随机元素中的2个元素的值来实现的。

blocks.en: The final pseudo-synthetic policy was obtained through a sequential, two-stage training process for the MLP classifier. Initially, the classification neural network was trained on the latent vectors derived from the 45225 synthetic images to learn a generalized base policy. Subsequently, this model was fine-tuned using the 18500 compressed representations corresponding to the augmented samples generated via latent-space manipulation, thereby allowing the final policy to benefit from both broad generalization and targeted adaptation.
blocks.zh: 最终的伪合成政策是通过MLP分类器的相继分出两个阶段的训练过程获得的. 最初,分类神经网络接受了关于从45225合成图像中衍生出的潜在向量的培训,以学习一个通用的基础政策. 随后,该模型利用与通过潜在空间操纵产生的扩大样品相对应的18500个压缩表达方式进行了微调,从而使最终政策能够从广义的概括化和有针对性的调整中受益。

blocks.en: 4.2 Training and Evaluation Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训和评价数据集

blocks.en: The empirical validation of our transfer learning method relies on several distinct datasets for training and evaluation, sourced from both the simulated and real-world domains. As detailed in Subsection 3.1 our data acquisition protocol yielded two primary training sets. The first is an extensive, balanced collection of 45225 synthetic images captured within our high-fidelity physics simulator, which serves as the foundation for the domain randomization stage. The second is a much smaller set of 4556 labeled images captured with the physical robot in the corresponding real-world environment, intended for the domain adaptation phase. To facilitate supervised learning, all samples across both datasets were annotated with one of four possible navigation commands: forward , right , left , and stop , as shown in Fig. 3 (a) and Fig. 3 (b).
blocks.zh: 我们转让学习方法的经验验证依赖于几个不同的数据集,用于培训和评价,这些数据集来自模拟领域和现实领域。 如第3.1分节所详述,我们的数据获取程序产生了两套初级培训。 第一种是广泛,平衡地收集了我们高活性物理模拟器所捕获的45225个合成图像,这作为域随机化阶段的基础. 第二种是一套较小的4556个被标注的图像,在相应的现实世界环境中与物理机器人一起被捕获,用于域改造阶段. 为了便于有监督的学习,两个数据集的所有样本都附有四个可能的导航命令之一:前行、右行、左行和停(见图3(a)和图3(b)。

blocks.en: To enhance the domain adaptation process and further bridge the sim-to-real gap, the limited real-world dataset was expanded using the two complementary data augmentation techniques presented in Subsection 3.3 . This process generated additional realistic training samples through both image-space transformations and latent-space manipulation. Fig. 3 (c) and Fig. 3 (d) provide illustrative examples from each of these data categories.
blocks.zh: 为加强域内适应进程并进一步弥合实际差距,利用第3.3分节中介绍的两种补充数据增强技术扩大了有限的现实世界数据集。 这一过程通过图像-空间转换和潜在的空间操纵,产生了更多的现实的培训样本。 图3(c)和图3(d)提供了每个数据类别的示例。

blocks.en: For a rigorous and unbiased assessment of the learned policies, we curated three distinct, balanced, and labeled test datasets, all of which were entirely unseen during any training or fine-tuning phase. The composition of these evaluation sets is detailed in Table 1 . The first set comprises non-augmented real-world images and was created using a 10-fold cross-validation protocol. The other two, larger sets consist of realistically transformed images, produced by applying slight, random modifications ( e.g. , to brightness, contrast, and saturation) to the original real-world samples. These augmented sets were designed to systematically test the generalization and adaptation capabilities of the learned policies under plausible environmental variations that a robot would encounter in practice. For instance, random modifications to image brightness help simulate different lighting conditions that might occur in real-world settings.
blocks.zh: 为了严格和不带偏见地评估所学到的政策,我们整理了三个不同的、平衡的和贴有标签的测试数据集,所有这些数据集在任何培训或微调阶段都完全看不到。 这些评价组的组成详见表1。 第一套由非强化现实世界图像组成,使用10倍的交叉验证协议创建. 另外两套,更大的一组由现实地被转换成的图像组成,通过将轻微的,随机的修改(例如,对亮度,对比度,和饱和度)应用到原始真实世界样本中来产生. 这些扩大的组合旨在系统地测试在机器人在实践中可能遇到的可行环境变化中,所学到政策的一般化和适应能力。 例如,对图像亮度的随机修改有助于模拟现实世界环境中可能出现的不同照明条件。

blocks.en: 4.3 Training Configuration and Optimizer Selection
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训配置和优化选择

blocks.en: This subsection outlines the configuration of the training phase for our deep neural network architectures. The core of the proposed training methodology, detailed in Algorithm 1 , is centered on the variational autoencoders, as the subsequent classification neural network is a very compact multi-layer perceptron. As specified in Subsection 4.1 , our image classification model consists of only three layers. Therefore, the primary challenge lies in effectively training and, most critically, fine-tuning our autoencoders to successfully bridge the simulation-to-reality gap.
blocks.zh: 本分节概述了我们深层神经网络架构培训阶段的配置. 由Algorithm 1所详述的拟议训练方法的核心以可变自编码器为中心,因为后来的分类神经网络是一个非常紧凑的多层受体. 如分节4.1所指明,我们的图像分类模型仅由三层组成. 因此,主要的挑战在于有效培训,最关键的是调整我们的自动编码器,以成功弥合模拟与现实之间的差距。

blocks.en: To achieve stable and efficient convergence, we employed the Root Mean Square Propagation (RMSProp) optimizer. RMSProp is an adaptive learning rate method developed to overcome some limitations of standard stochastic gradient descent by adapting the step size using mean moments. Its mechanism limits oscillations during the descent phase, allowing for more substantial and effective steps in the correct direction of convergence [ 55 ]. These adaptive capabilities are highly advantageous for a deep transfer learning problem such as this, particularly during the delicate fine-tuning stage where the model must adapt to the subtle visual discrepancies of the real domain ( e.g. , textures, lighting, and sensor noise) without catastrophically forgetting the robust, general features learned from simulation.
blocks.zh: 为了实现稳定和高效的趋同,我们采用了根平方宣传(RMSProp)优化器. RMSProp是一种适应性学习速率方法,通过使用平均瞬间来调整步法大小来克服标准分层梯度下降的一些局限性. 其机制限制了下降阶段的振荡,使得在正确的趋同方向上能够采取更实质性和更有效的步骤[55]. 这些适应能力对于诸如这种深刻的转移学习问题非常有利,特别是在微妙的微调阶段,模型必须适应真实域的微妙视觉差异(例如纹理、照明和传感器噪音),而不会灾难性地忘记从模拟中吸取的强健而一般的特征。

blocks.en: The specific hyperparameter values used for both the initial training and the subsequent fine-tuning stages are presented in Table 2 . The choice of a conservative learning rate, combined with the adaptive nature of RMSProp, provides the necessary stability for the fine-tuning process. This combination constitutes a robust training protocol, enabling our pseudo-synthetic VAE to effectively learn a powerful common representation space for successful sim-to-real transfer.
blocks.zh: 初始培训和随后微调阶段使用的具体超参数值见表2。 选择保守的学习率,加上RMSProp的适应性,为微调过程提供了必要的稳定性. 这种组合构成一个强大的训练规程,使我们的伪合成VAE能够有效地学习一个强大的共同代表空间,以成功实现模拟到实际的转移.

blocks.en: 4.4 Qualitative Analysis of Reconstruction Capabilities
blocks.zh: 4.4 重建能力定性分析

blocks.en: This subsection presents a qualitative assessment of the deep generative models trained across our three experiments. The evaluation focuses on the image reconstruction quality of each convolutional variational autoencoder, which was tasked with generating images from real input samples randomly selected from the test datasets detailed in Table 1 . The process involved encoding the 64x64 RGB test images into 32-dimensional latent vectors, which then served as input to the respective decoders for reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 本分节对经过我们三个实验培训的深层基因模型进行了定性评估。 评估的重点是每个变相自编码器的图像重建质量,它的任务是从表1所详述的测试数据集中随机选择的真正输入样本生成图像。 这一过程涉及将64x64的RGB测试图像编码为32维潜向量,然后作为相应的解码器重建的输入.

blocks.en: It is crucial to frame this analysis within the specific goals of our application. The primary objective of our variational autoencoders is not to achieve photo-realistic, high-fidelity reconstructions, a task for which other specialized generative architectures are better suited [ 56 , 57 ]. Instead, for tasks like autonomous navigation, the characteristically blurred output of VAEs can be re-contextualized as a powerful form of implicit regularization.
blocks.zh: 必须在我们应用的具体目标范围内进行这种分析。 我们的变异自编码器的首要目的不是实现相片现实化,高真实度的重建,而其他专业的基因结构更适合完成这项任务[56,57]. 相反地,对于自主导航等任务来说,VAEs的典型模糊输出可以被重新编译为一种强大的隐性规范化形式.

blocks.en: The process of compressing high-dimensional visual information through a low-dimensional latent bottleneck naturally filters out high-frequency, domain-specific details ( e.g. , wall textures). Simultaneously, it preserves the low-frequency, structural information ( e.g. , corridor geometry and obstacle shapes) that is most critical for embodied navigation and most likely to be invariant across the sim-to-real gap. This capacity for feature abstraction is particularly effective for low-cost robotic platforms that rely on a single monocular RGB camera, as it facilitates the extraction of task-relevant cues from limited sensory input, enabling efficient and rapid decision-making for real-time reactive navigation.
blocks.zh: 通过低维潜在瓶颈来压缩高维视觉信息的过程自然会过滤出高频,有域特异性的细节(如:墙纹理等). 同时,它保存了对所体现导航最为关键,而且最有可能跨越正对正对正差距的低频结构信息(例如走廊几何和障碍形状)。 这种特征抽象能力对于依赖单一单相机的低成本机器人平台特别有效,因为它有利于从有限的感官输入中提取出与任务相關的提示,使实时反应导航能够高效而迅速地决策.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Reconstructions generated by the decoder of our three convolutional variational autoencoders from input real image data. (a) Test images reconstructed using the real-only autoencoder trained for Experiment (1). (b) Test images reconstructed through the sim-only autoencoder trained in Experiment (2). (c) Test images reconstructed using our proposed pseudo-synthetic autoencoder trained and fine-tuned for Experiment (3).
blocks.zh: 图4:从输入真实图像数据中解码器生成的重建。 (a) 使用为实验所训练的实际唯一自编码器进行重建的测试图像(1)。 (b) 通过在实验(2)中训练的Sim-Only自编码器来重建的测试图像。 (c) 使用我们提议的伪合成自编码器重新制作的测试图像,经过培训和精细校正,用于实验(3)。

blocks.en: Our observations confirmed a direct correlation: deep generative models that produced higher-quality structural reconstructions yielded better downstream classification performance. As shown in Fig. 4 (a) and Fig. 4 (c), the VAEs from Experiments (1) and (3) successfully reconstructed the global structure of our real indoor environment, accurately capturing the obstacles and general lighting conditions present in the original images. These two DL models, which produced reconstructions of similar quality, exhibited some difficulty only in reconstructing high-frequency details, such as the floor texture, which aligns with the expected behavior of the variational autoencoder as a structural feature extractor.
blocks.zh: 我们的观察证实了一种直接的关联性:产生高质量结构重建的深层基因模型产生了更好的下游分类性能. 如图4(a)和图4(c)所示,实验(1)和(3)的VAE成功地重建了我们真实室内环境的全球结构,准确地抓住了原始图像中存在的障碍和一般照明条件。 这两种DL模型产生出质量相近的重建,仅在高频细节的重建中表现出了一定的困难,例如地板纹理,它与可变自编码器作为结构特征提取器的预期行为相配合.

blocks.en: In contrast, and as anticipated, the generative model from Experiment (2) produced more blurred reconstructions, a direct consequence of its exclusive training on simulation data. However, even in this case, as depicted in Fig. 4 (b), the global structure and key obstacles within the real environment remained identifiable, demonstrating that the model still learned geometrically salient features despite the significant domain shift.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,正如所预期的那样,实验(2)的基因模型产生了更模糊的重建,这是其独有的模拟数据培训的直接结果. 然而,即使如图4(b)所描述的那样,全球结构和实际环境中的关键障碍仍然可以识别,表明尽管域名发生了重大变化,但模型仍然掌握了几何特征。

blocks.en: 4.5 Quantitative Analysis of Classification Performance
blocks.zh: 4.5 分类业绩定量分析

blocks.en: To complement the qualitative findings, this subsection presents a quantitative assessment of the classification policies learned across our three experimental setups. We evaluated the performance of each classification neural network using the autoencoders previously analyzed. The evaluation was conducted on the three balanced, labeled test datasets detailed in Table 1 , calculating mean accuracy rates along with corresponding median and variance values.
blocks.zh: 为了补充定性结论,本分节对从我们三个实验机构学到的分类政策进行了定量评估。 我们用以前分析过的自动编码器 评估了每个分类神经网络的性能 评价是根据表1所详述的三个平衡、贴有标签的测试数据集进行的,计算平均准确率以及相应的中位数和相差值。

blocks.en: These metrics were obtained when using our three distinct deep neural network architectures to predict probabilities associated with the four navigation categories ( i.e. , forward , right , left , and stop ). To ensure statistical robustness, the policy performance on the non-augmented real-world test set was measured using a 10-fold cross-validation protocol, while results on the two realistically transformed test sets were averaged over 10 independent runs. The results are summarized in Fig. 5 .
blocks.zh: 这些度量衡是在使用我们三个截然不同的深神经网络架构来预测与这四个导航类别(即:前向,右向,左向,并停止)相关的概率时获得的. 为确保统计稳健性,用10倍的交叉验证协议衡量了非强化现实世界测试集的政策业绩,而两套实际转换测试集的结果平均为10多套独立运行。 图5概述了结果。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Mean accuracy rates, along with corresponding median and variance values, obtained when predicting probabilities related to the four possible ground-truth labels used to annotate input real images. We achieved the final results using three distinct classification models: the real-only image classifier (blue) trained for Experiment (1), the sim-only image classifier (orange) trained in Experiment (2), and our proposed pseudo-synthetic image classifier (green) trained and fine-tuned for Experiment (3). The reported accuracy percentages resulted from evaluating each classifier using three different test datasets, presented in decreasing order of importance.
blocks.zh: 图5:平均准确率,连同相应的中位数和相差值,在预测与用于注释输入真实图像的四种可能地面-真实标签有关的概率时获得. 我们利用三种不同的分类模型取得了最终结果:为实验(1)所训练的真-唯图像分级器(蓝色),为实验(2)所训练的sim-只图像分级器(橙色),以及我们提议的为实验(3)所训练并微调的伪合成分级器(绿色). 报告的准确性百分比是根据使用三个不同的测试数据集对每个分类器进行评价的结果,这些数据集按重要性的下降顺序排列。

blocks.en: The real-only model from Experiment (1) achieved a moderate mean accuracy of 67.16% on the primary (CV) test set. This performance reflects the inherent limitations of training a deep learning model with a small, sparsely-distributed real-world dataset. However, this deep neural network architecture showed remarkable adaptability to plausible environmental variations, achieving mean accuracy rates exceeding 80% for the two sets of realistic samples generated through image-space transformations.
blocks.zh: 来自"实验(1)"的活性模型在初级(CV)测试集上实现了67.16%的中度平均精度. 这一表现反映了训练一个带有一个小而分散的实时世界数据集的深层学习模型的固有局限性. 然而,这种深层神经网络结构显示出对可能的环境变化的显著适应性,通过图像-空间转换生成的两组现实样本的平均准确率超过80%。

blocks.en: Conversely, the synthetic model from Experiment (2), trained exclusively on simulated data, performed poorly, failing to surpass a 35% mean accuracy on any real test set. This result quantitatively underscores the significant reality gap that persists when domain adaptation is not employed.
blocks.zh: 反之,仅接受模拟数据培训的实验(2)合成模型表现不佳,未能在任何真正的测试中超过35%的精度。 这一结果在数量上突出表明了在不采用领域适应办法时持续存在的重大现实差距。

blocks.en: In contrast, our proposed pseudo-synthetic model from Experiment (3) demonstrated superior predictive capacity, achieving a mean accuracy of 90.88% on the (CV) test set. However, compared to Experiment (1), this deep neural network architecture showed lower adaptation ability to the varying circumstances represented in our last two test sets, achieving mean accuracy rates of approximately 60%.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,我们从实验(3)中提议的伪合成模型显示出了优异的预测能力,在(CV)测试集上实现了90.88%的平均精度. 然而,与实验(1)相比,这种深层神经网络架构显示适应我们前两套测试中反映的不同情况的能力较低,平均准确率约为60%。

blocks.en: The significant improvement achieved by the pseudo-synthetic model on the (CV) test dataset highlights the efficacy of our hybrid transfer learning strategy, centered on the dual encoder, shared decoder architecture. While a direct ablation study comparing shared versus independent decoders was not conducted, this architectural choice is rigorously supported by established principles in domain adaptation and incremental learning.
blocks.zh: 伪合成模型在(CV)测试数据集上实现的重大改进,凸显出我们以双编码器,共享解码器架构为核心的混合转移学习策略的功效. 虽然没有进行直接的对共享与独立解码器进行比较的研究,但这种建筑选择得到了域内适应和渐进学习的既定原则的有力支持。

blocks.en: Crucially, our design adheres to the “shared latent space assumption” formally analyzed by Huang et al. [ 58 ], who posit that corresponding images in different domains can be mapped to a common latent code. In a dual VAE framework, the shared decoder acts as a critical structural constraint that forces the latent spaces of both simulation and reality to align within the same semantic manifold. Without this shared component, there is no mathematical pressure to ensure that a latent representation z i z_{i} carries the same navigation-relevant meaning across domains, leading to a divergence that would render the simulation-trained policy ineffective in real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh: 关键的是,我们的设计坚持了由黄克华等人正式分析的“共享潜在空间假设”,他们假定不同领域的相应图像可以被映射成共同的潜在代码。 在一个双重的VAE框架内,共享解码器起着关键的结构性制约作用,迫使模拟和现实的潜在空间在同一语义多相配合. 没有这一共同组成部分,就没有数学压力来确保潜在的代表z i z_{i}在各个领域具有相同的导航相关含义,从而导致分歧,使模拟训练政策在现实世界中无效。

blocks.en: Furthermore, the use of a shared decoder is a recognized mechanism for mitigating catastrophic forgetting during the fine-tuning of deep generative models. As demonstrated by Dai et al. [ 59 ] in the context of multi-task incremental learning, unshared decoders often result in the overwriting of source knowledge because gradients derived from the target domain only update domain-specific paths, causing a sudden decrease in performance for the original tasks. Their empirical results showed a significant performance gap when shifting from shared to unshared decoders ( e.g. , a drop in category extraction for sentiment analysis from 0.913 to 0.842), validating that parameter sharing weakens the interference between old and new knowledge.
blocks.zh: 此外,使用共同编码器是在微调深层基因模型的过程中减轻灾难性遗忘的一种公认机制。 如戴等所证. [59] 在多任务增量学习的背景下,未共享的解码器往往导致源知识被覆盖,因为从目标域得到的梯度只更新了域特有路径,导致原任务的性能突然下降. 其经验结果显示,当从共享解码器向非共享解码器转变时,存在显著的性能差距(例如,用于情绪分析的分类提取从0.913降至0.842),验证了参数共享削弱了新旧知识之间的干扰.

blocks.en: In our specific case of low-cost robotic navigation, where real-world data is limited to only 4556 images, the shared decoder serves as a “generative constraint” [ 60 ]. This constraint amortizes the structural knowledge learned from our 45225 simulated images, acting as a regularizer that prevents the encoder from overfitting to the small real-world dataset. By freezing the decoder parameters during adaptation, a technique also explored by Inoue et al. [ 11 ], we ensure that the latent space remains anchored to the robust geometry learned in simulation while the encoder learns to map noisy physical inputs into this pre-structured space. Consequently, the shared decoder is not merely an empirical heuristic but a systemic requirement for stable sim-to-real transfer under resource-constrained conditions, leading to the high 90.88% classification performance observed.
blocks.zh: 在我们的低成本机器人导航这一具体案例中,现实世界数据仅限于4556个图像,共享的解码器是“遗传性制约”[60]。 这种约束将从我们45225模拟图像中吸取的结构性知识分期摊还,起到常态化的作用,防止编码器过度地适应了小型现实世界数据集. Inoue et al. [11] 也探索了一种技术,通过在适应过程中冻结解码器参数,我们确保潜在的空间仍然被固定在模拟中学会的强健的几何学上,而编码器则学会将吵闹的物理输入映射到这个预先结构的空间上。 因此,共享解码器不仅是一种经验主义的heuristic,而且是一种在资源受限的条件下实现稳定的正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablation Study: Impact of Data Augmentation Strategy
blocks.zh: 4.6 关联研究:数据增强的影响 战略

blocks.en: To rigorously quantify the contribution of the domain alignment strategies detailed in Subsection 3.3 , and to distinguish the efficacy of our full hybrid framework from a standard dual VAE architecture ( e.g. , as proposed in related works such as Inoue et al. [ 11 ]), we conducted an ablation study. In this experiment, we trained the exact same neural network architecture described in Subsection 4.1 using the configuration of Experiment (3), but with the specific exclusion of the two complementary data augmentation stages ( i.e. , image-space transformations and latent-space manipulation). Consequently, the model relied solely on the shared decoder constraint to align the 45225 simulated images and the 4556 real-world images without the expansive bridging provided by the augmented datasets.
blocks.zh: 为了严格量化第3.3分节所详述的域调和战略的贡献,并区分我们整个混合框架的功效与标准的双重VAE架构(例如,如Inoue等相关著作所提议[11]),我们开展了一项调和研究. 在这次实验中,我们使用实验(3)的配置来训练了第4.1分节所描述的完全相同的神经网络架构,但具体排除了两个互补的数据增强阶段(即图像-空间转换和潜入空间操纵). 因此,该模型完全依赖共享的解码器制约,将45225个模拟图像和4556个真实世界的图像对齐,而没有扩大的数据集提供的宽广连接。

blocks.en: The results, evaluated on our 4-action space ( i.e. , move forward, turn right, turn left, and stop) across the three test datasets, are presented in Table 3 . The comparison reveals a critical dependency on the proposed augmentation techniques. When the augmentation strategies are removed, the mean accuracy on the primary (CV) dataset precipitates from 90.88% to 47.06%. This represents a performance drop of 43.82 percentage points. Similarly, performance on the realistically transformed datasets (T1) and (T2) degrades to levels only marginally superior to the simulation-only baseline ( i.e. , Experiment (2)), with accuracies of 39.15% and 34.20%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在三个测试数据集的4个行动空间(即前进、向右转、向左转和站住)上评估的结果见表3。 比较表明,对拟议扩增技术的依赖十分严重。 在取消扩增战略后,主数据集的平均准确率从90.88%升至47.06%。 这说明业绩下降了43.82个百分点。 同样,实际转换的数据集(T1)和(T2)的性能只比模拟基准(即实验(2))略高,分别为39.15%和34.20%。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation study mean accuracy rates comparing the proposed full hybrid framework against a baseline implementation without the data augmentation strategies described in Subsection 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 表3: 通配性研究是指在没有第3.3分节所描述的数据增强战略的情况下,将拟议的完整混合框架与基线执行相比较的准确率。

blocks.en: These findings provide empirical evidence that the dual VAE architecture with a shared decoder is, by itself, insufficient to bridge the reality gap when dealing with limited, unpaired real-world data. While the shared decoder provides a necessary structural constraint, the ablation results demonstrate that the high generalization capability of our system, able to obtain nearly 91% accuracy, is primarily driven by the novel alignment achieved through the proposed augmentation stages. These techniques are therefore confirmed not as optional enhancements, but as fundamental components required to effectively map the sparse real-world distribution into the shared latent manifold.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果提供了实证证据,证明带有共享解码器的双重VAE架构本身不足以弥补在处理有限而未公开的真实世界数据时的现实差距. 虽然共享的解码器提供了必要的结构制约,但减值结果表明,我们系统的高通化能力,能够获得近91%的准确性,主要由通过拟议增强阶段实现的新调整所驱动. 因此,这些技术不是可选的增强手段,而是有效将稀有的现实世界分布图绘制成共同的潜在多面图所需的基本组成部分。

blocks.en: 4.7 Policy Analysis for Reactive Collision-Free Navigation
blocks.zh: 4.7 反应碰撞-自由航行政策分析

blocks.en: To further examine the practical effectiveness of the learned policies, this subsection evaluates their potential application within a reactive, map-less navigation system. The scenario involves a low-cost robot equipped with a single monocular RGB camera exploring a real indoor corridor, making decisions based on the test images from our evaluation datasets.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步审查所学到的政策的实际效果,本分节评价这些政策在一个被动的、无地图的导航系统中的潜在应用。 方案涉及一个低成本机器人,配备一台单相机RGB相机,探索真正的室内走廊,根据我们评价数据集的测试图像作出决定。

blocks.en: For this task-oriented analysis, we simplified the classification problem by reducing the action space from four distinct commands to three functional categories: forward , turn , and stop . In this simplified framework, we considered predictions correct if the network selected any turning action ( i.e. , turn right or turn left) when the ground truth indicated either right or left turns. This simplification is justified in reactive collision avoidance, where the imperative to initiate an evasive turn to avoid an obstacle is often more critical than the specific direction of the maneuver.
blocks.zh: 对于这个面向任务的分析,我们简化了分类问题,将动作空间从四个不同的指令缩小为三个功能类别:前进,转弯,停止. 在这个简化的框架中,我们认为,当地面真理显示左右转弯时,如果网络选择任何转弯动作(即向右转或向左转),那么预测是正确的. 这种简化是避免被动碰撞的正当理由,在这种情况下,启动避免障碍的避让性转弯往往比操作的具体方向更为关键。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Predictions and reconstructions obtained from labeled real images using our proposed pseudo-synthetic model trained in Experiment (3). These tests focused on reactive collision-free exploration tasks in the real world, involving reconstruction of input images and their classification into three categories: forward , turn , and stop . (a) Test image data representing scenarios requiring forward actions. (b) Test image data corresponding to situations requiring turn commands. (c) Test image data representing circumstances requiring stop actions.
blocks.zh: 图6:使用我们在实验(3)中培训的拟议伪合成模型,从贴有标签的真实图像中获得的预测与重建. 这些测试侧重于现实世界中的反应性无相撞探索任务,涉及输入图像的重建及其分类,分为三类:前进、转向和停止。 (a) 测试图象数据,说明需要采取前瞻性行动的情景。 (b) 测试与需要回合命令的情况相适应的图像数据。 (c) 测试显示需要停止行动的情况的图像数据。

blocks.en: The analysis of our proposed pseudo-synthetic policy from Experiment (3) demonstrates its high potential for successful real-world deployment. As illustrated in Fig. 6 (b), the model exhibits intelligent reactive behavior. For instance, in a scenario consisting of a column beside a window, the ground-truth label indicated a right turn. In this case, the policy still predicted a correct turning action, albeit in the opposite direction ( i.e. , to the left). In a reactive context, this is a successful outcome, as the robot would still perform the necessary evasive maneuver to avoid collision and continue its exploration.
blocks.zh: 对实验(3)提出的伪合成政策的分析表明,它具有成功部署现实世界的巨大潜力。 如图6(b)所示,模型显示了智能反应行为。 例如,在一个由一柱子组成的窗口旁的情景中,地面真实的标签是右转。 在这种情况下,政策仍然预想着正确的转变行动,尽管方向相反(即向左). 在被动环境下,这是一个成功的结果,因为机器人仍然会进行必要的避让操作来避免相撞并继续探索.

blocks.en: Furthermore, as shown in Fig. 6 (a) and Fig. 6 (c), our transfer learning approach would also enable successful collision-free exploration in scenarios requiring forward movement in open spaces or stopping. Notably, the robot would successfully execute three consecutive stop commands to avoid collision with a person standing directly in front of it while reaching toward its camera.
blocks.zh: 此外,如图6(a)和图6(c)所示,我们的转移学习方法还将能够在需要在开放空间前进或停止的情况下成功进行无相撞探索。 值得注意的是,机器人将成功执行连续三站指令,以避免在接近相机时与直立站前的人相撞.

blocks.en: As expected, evaluating the learned policies under this simplified three-category framework led to a general improvement in their mean accuracy rates. The updated quantitative results for all three architectures are presented in Table 4 . Notably, our pseudo-synthetic policy maintained its superior accuracy of 90.88% on the primary (CV) test set, reinforcing the robustness of our proposed transfer learning approach for practical navigation tasks.
blocks.zh: 如所期望的那样,评价在这一简化的三类框架下学到的政策导致其平均准确率普遍提高。 所有三个架构的最新量化结果见表4。 值得注意的是,我们的伪合成政策在初级(CV)测试集上保持了90.88%的优越精度,加强了我们提出的实际导航任务转移学习方法的稳健性。
