blocks.en: 4.8 Analysis of Latent Representation Spaces
blocks.zh: 4.8 后期代表空间分析

blocks.en: 4.8.1 Qualitative Evaluation of Latent Space Organization
blocks.zh: 4.8.1 晚期空间组织的质量评估

blocks.en: A fundamental challenge in autonomous navigation is the ability to learn a well-structured latent space that effectively encodes meaningful spatial features from raw visual inputs. This subsection examines the latent spaces generated by the three convolutional variational autoencoders from our experiments. This analysis serves as a practical and insightful alternative to direct real-world deployment, offering valuable information about the quality of the learned representations and the expected system behavior. For this purpose, we utilize the simplified three-category action space ( forward , turn , and stop ) established in the preceding subsection.
blocks.zh: 自主导航的一个根本挑战是能否学习一个结构完善的潜在空间,从原始视觉输入中有效地编码有意义的空间特征。 本分节研究了我们实验中三个相变自编码器产生的潜在空间. 这一分析是直接进行现实世界部署的一种实际而有见地的替代办法,它提供了关于所学表现和预期系统行为质量的宝贵信息。 为此,我们利用上分节中建立的简化的三类行动空间(向前、转向和停止)。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Two-dimensional t-SNE visualization of the latent spaces generated from the non-augmented real-world (CV) test set. (a) Latent space from the real-only autoencoder. (b) Latent space from the sim-only autoencoder. (c) Latent space from the proposed pseudo-synthetic autoencoder.
blocks.zh: 图7:二维 t-SNE可视化非增强现实世界(CV)测试集所产生的潜在空间. (a) 来自唯一自动编码器的慢化空间。 (b) 来自 sim-Only 自动编码器的缓冲空间。 (c) 拟议的伪合成自编码器的底片空间。

blocks.en: To visualize and interpret the 32-dimensional latent vectors produced by our autoencoders, we employed the t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE) technique. This non-linear dimensionality reduction method is particularly effective for visualizing high-dimensional data, as it excels at preserving local relationships between data points and revealing the underlying cluster structure in a low-dimensional map [ 61 ]. By mapping high-dimensional representations to a 2D space, t-SNE allows for the identification of clusters corresponding to different navigation commands, thus revealing the organizational quality of the learned latent space.
blocks.zh: 为了可视化和解读我们自动编码器产生的32维潜在向量,我们采用了t-分布相邻嵌入(t-SNE)技术. 这种非线性维度还原法对于可视化高维数据特别有效,因为它在保存数据点之间的局部关系和在低维地图中揭示基础的集群结构方面非常出色. [61]. T-SNE通过将高维度的表示图映射到一个2D空间,可以识别出与不同的导航指令相对应的集群,从而揭示出所学到的潜在空间的组织质量.

blocks.en: The t-SNE visualizations reveal different organizational patterns across the three models. For the non-augmented real-world (CV) test set, as observed in Fig. 7 (c), the pseudo-synthetic autoencoder produced a remarkably well-organized latent space with clearly separated clusters corresponding to the different navigation actions. This highly structured representation directly correlates with its superior mean classification accuracy of 90.88%. In contrast, as shown in Fig. 7 (a), the real-only model produced a space with moderately defined clusters, consistent with its 72.57% accuracy. The sim-only autoencoder, in turn, generated a largely unstructured space with significant class overlap, depicted in Fig. 7 (b), reflecting its poor generalization and 32.92% accuracy.
blocks.zh: t-SNE可视化显示三个模型的不同组织模式. 如图7(c)所示,对于非强化现实世界(CV)测试集,伪合成自编码器产生了一个非常有条理的潜伏空间,与不同的导航行动相对应,有着明显的分离集群。 这种高度结构化的表述与其90.88%的高级平均分类精度直接相关。 相比之下,如图7(a)所显示,只有真实的模型产生了一个有中度定义的星团的空间,与其72.57%的精确度一致。 Sim-Only自编码器反过来又产生了一个基本没有结构的空间,有显著的类相重叠,用图7(b)来描述,反映了它的简略性差和32.92%的准确性.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Two-dimensional t-SNE visualization of the latent spaces generated from the realistically transformed (T1) test set. (a) Latent space from the real-only autoencoder. (b) Latent space from the sim-only autoencoder. (c) Latent space from the proposed pseudo-synthetic autoencoder.
blocks.zh: 图8 二维 t-SNE可视化由现实变形(T1)测试集所生成的潜在空间. (a) 来自唯一自动编码器的慢化空间。 (b) 来自 sim-Only 自动编码器的缓冲空间。 (c) 拟议的伪合成自编码器的底片空间。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Two-dimensional t-SNE visualization of the latent spaces generated from the realistically transformed (T2) test set. (a) Latent space from the real-only autoencoder. (b) Latent space from the sim-only autoencoder. (c) Latent space from the proposed pseudo-synthetic autoencoder.
blocks.zh: 图9 二维 t-SNE可视化由现实变形(T2)测试集所生成的潜在空间. (a) 来自唯一自动编码器的慢化空间。 (b) 来自 sim-Only 自动编码器的缓冲空间。 (c) 拟议的伪合成自编码器的底片空间。

blocks.en: For the augmented test sets (T1) and (T2), depicted in Fig. 8 and Fig. 9 , the latent spaces of the real-only autoencoder demonstrated improved cluster formation, aligning with enhanced mean classification accuracies of 81.76% and 83.91%, respectively. In contrast, poor organizational patterns persisted when using the sim-only model, especially with the (T2) dataset. Finally, the latent spaces of the pseudo-synthetic autoencoder showed somewhat reduced cluster definition compared to the (CV) set, corresponding to its lower classification performance on these specifically transformed datasets.
blocks.zh: 对于图8和图9中描述的扩增测试集(T1)和(T2),实际唯一自动编码器的潜在空间显示出集群形成有所改善,与分别达到81.76%和83.91%的强化平均分类速率一致。 相比之下,在使用只使用模拟模型时,特别是在使用(T2)数据集时,组织模式不佳。 最后,与(CV)集相比,伪合成自编码器的潜在空间显示集群定义有所降低,这与其在这些被具体转换的数据集上的较低分类性能相对应.

blocks.en: The organization of samples within the latent spaces provides significant information about the capability of our proposed VAE to learn visual features relevant for autonomous reactive navigation. Several observable subclusters within the three action categories in the pseudo-synthetic latent spaces likely represent variations within specific navigation actions ( e.g. , distinguishing between right and left turns, or between forward movements in different areas of the environment). These detailed distinctions might contribute significantly to the superior performance of the model in real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh: 在潜在空间中组织样品提供了重要信息,说明我们提议的紫外线观测能够学习与自主反应导航有关的视觉特征。 伪合成潜入空间中三个行动类别中的若干可观察到的子集群可能代表了特定导航行动(例如,区分右转和左转,或环境不同领域的前向运动)中的差异。 这些详细的区分可能大大有助于模型在现实世界情景中的优异表现。

blocks.en: The relative positions of clusters within the latent space also reveal specific relationships between different navigation actions. For instance, the spatial proximity between forward and turn clusters in Fig. 8 (c) might indicate a learned understanding of the sequential relationship between these two action categories, particularly appropriate for autonomous exploration applications.
blocks.zh: 集群在潜在空间中的相对位置也揭示出不同导航行动之间的具体关系. 例如,图8(c)中的前向和后向集群之间的空间相近可能表明对这两个行动类别之间顺序关系的了解,特别是对于自主勘探应用而言。

blocks.en: In turn, the stop action usually formed a more clearly separated cluster, reflecting its fundamental difference from actions involving movement. Nevertheless, as depicted in Fig. 9 (c), there is significant overlap between the categories of turning and stopping actions. This could lead to errors in subsequent classification of input samples and, consequently, to a considerable decrease in system performance. In a potential exploration application, this limitation could translate into suboptimal decisions. For instance, the robot might stop unnecessarily in a space where a turn action would provide greater environmental coverage. Conversely, it could lead to critical errors, such as attempting to turn when facing a close obstacle where only a stop action could prevent a collision.
blocks.zh: 反过来,停止行动通常形成一个更明确分开的集群,反映了它与涉及移动的行动的根本区别. 然而,如图9(c)所描述的,转动和停止行动类别之间有重大重叠。 这可能导致随后输入样品的分类出错,从而导致系统性能大幅下降. 在可能提出的勘探申请中,这种限制可能转化为不理想的决定。 例如,机器人可能会在转动行动将扩大环境覆盖的空间中不必要地停止。 相反,它可能导致重大错误,例如在遇到只有停止行动才能防止相撞的紧密障碍时试图转向。

blocks.en: 4.8.2 Quantitative Evaluation of Cluster Validity
blocks.zh: 4.8.2 对集群有效性的定量评估

blocks.en: To complement this visual assessment and provide a more rigorous evaluation, we conducted a quantitative analysis of the generated latent spaces. This analysis employs three widely-recognized internal Cluster Validity Indices (CVIs) [ 62 ] to measure the quality of the clusters formed in the t-SNE representations. The selected metrics are:
blocks.zh: 为了补充这一视觉评估,并提供更严格的评估,我们对产生的潜在空间进行了定量分析。 本分析采用被广泛承认的三种内部集群有效性指数[62]来衡量在T-SNE表述中形成的集群的质量。 选定的衡量标准如下:

blocks.en: 1. The Silhouette Index, which evaluates how well-separated and compact clusters are. Its value ranges from -1 to 1, where a score closer to 1 indicates that data points are well-matched to their own cluster and poorly matched to neighboring clusters, signifying a high-quality partition [ 62 ]. A higher Silhouette score is preferable. 2. The Davies-Bouldin (DB) Index, which computes the average similarity between each cluster and its most similar one. It is defined as a minimization problem, where lower values indicate better clustering. A lower score implies that clusters are more compact and farther apart from each other [ 62 ]. 3. The Calinski-Harabasz (CH) Index, also known as the Variance Ratio Criterion, which measures the ratio of between-cluster to within-cluster dispersion. A higher CH score indicates denser and better-separated clusters, making it a maximization index [ 62 ].
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 Silhouette指数,它评价了如何将集群分开和紧凑。 其值从-1到1不等,接近1的分数表明,数据点与自己的集群非常匹配,与相邻的集群不匹配,意味着高质量的分区[62]. 提高Silhouette分数比较好. 2. Davies-Bouldin(DB)指数,该指数计算每个集群与其最相近集群之间的平均相似性。 它被定义为一个最小化问题,其中较低的值表示更好的集群. 分数更低意味着集群更加紧凑,相互间更相去更远[62]. 3. Calinski-Harabasz(CH)指数,又称差异比率标准,用来衡量集群与集群内部分散的比例。 较高的CH分数表示密度较大且分出分数较好的集群,使其成为一个最大化指数 [62].

blocks.en: The Silhouette Index, which evaluates how well-separated and compact clusters are. Its value ranges from -1 to 1, where a score closer to 1 indicates that data points are well-matched to their own cluster and poorly matched to neighboring clusters, signifying a high-quality partition [ 62 ]. A higher Silhouette score is preferable.

blocks.en: Table 5 presents the quantitative results, averaged over 10 independent test runs to account for the stochastic nature of t-SNE. For the (CV) dataset, the metrics strongly corroborate our qualitative findings: the pseudo-synthetic autoencoder achieves the best scores across all three indices, confirming the well-defined clusters observed visually in Fig. 7 (c). Conversely, the sim-only autoencoder yields the worst scores, including a negative Silhouette Index, reflecting the disorganized and overlapping latent space shown in Fig. 7 (b).
blocks.zh: 表5列出了量化结果,平均10多份独立测试,以说明T-SNE的花样特征。 就(CV)数据集而言,衡量标准有力地证实了我们的定性结论:伪合成自编码器在所有三个指数中都取得了最佳分数,证实了图7(c)中观察到的明确界定的集群。 反之,只使用 sim 自动编码器得出最差的分数,包括负Silhouette指数,反映了图7(b)所示的无组织和相重叠的潜在空间。

blocks.en: The results for the augmented datasets reveal a critical insight. On the (T2) dataset, the pseudo-synthetic model achieves exceptional CVI scores, yet its classification accuracy drops to 60.78%. This discrepancy suggests that while the model learns to form geometrically pure clusters based on low-level features introduced by the data augmentation, these clusters can become semantically confused. This underscores that optimizing for geometric cluster purity in the latent space does not guarantee improved performance on a downstream classification task, and that CVI metrics must be interpreted in conjunction with task-specific performance.
blocks.zh: 扩大数据集的结果揭示了一种重要的见解。 在(T2)数据集上,伪合成模型实现了特异性的CVI分数,然而其分类精度下降到了60.78%. 这种差异表明,虽然模型学会了在数据增强所引入的低等特征的基础上形成几何纯度的集群,但这些集群可能会在分解上变得混乱. 这突出表明,优化潜在空间中的几何组分纯度并不能保证下游分类任务的业绩得到改善,而CVI衡量标准必须结合具体任务的业绩加以解释。

blocks.en: 4.9 Computational Efficiency Analysis for Low-Cost Robotic Deployment
blocks.zh: 4.9 低成本机器人部署计算效率分析

blocks.en: The practical application of deep learning models in robotics is often constrained not only by predictive accuracy but also by computational efficiency, a factor of paramount importance for deployment on low-cost, resource-constrained platforms [ 63 ]. While the preceding sections have established the high classification accuracy of our proposed policy, this analysis aims to quantitatively validate its practical viability for real-time reactive navigation. A policy, no matter how effective in theory, is of limited use if its computational and memory requirements exceed the capabilities of affordable hardware. Therefore, this analysis serves as a critical bridge between theoretical performance and real-world deployability.
blocks.zh: 深层学习模型在机器人学中的实际应用往往不仅受到预测准确性的限制,而且受到计算效率的限制,这是在低成本、受资源限制的平台上部署的一个极其重要的因素[63]。 虽然前几节确定了我们拟议政策的高度分类准确性,但这一分析旨在从数量上验证其实时被动导航的实际可行性。 一项政策,无论在理论上多么有效,如果其计算和内存要求超过负担得起的硬件能力,其用途有限. 因此,这一分析是理论性能和现实世界可部署性之间的重要桥梁。

blocks.en: To provide a realistic assessment, we eschew simple theoretical peaks and instead employ the more nuanced Roofline model as originally proposed by Williams et al. [ 64 ]. The Roofline model is an insightful visual framework that bounds the attainable performance of a computational kernel by the hardware’s peak throughput and its peak memory bandwidth [ 64 ]. We adopt its more complex formulation, which incorporates intermediate ceilings to represent the performance limitations imposed by the absence of specific software optimizations or by systemic overheads [ 64 ].
blocks.zh: 为了提供现实的评估,我们回避简单的理论峰值,而是采用威廉斯等最初提出的更细微的Roofline模型. [64]. Roofline模型是一个有洞察力的视觉框架,它通过硬件的峰值吞吐量及其峰值内存带宽[64]来限制一个计算内核的可实现性能. 我们采用其更为复杂的表述方式,其中包含中间上限,以表示由于缺乏具体软件优化或系统间接费用而施加的性能限制[64]。

blocks.en: This approach yields a more conservative and pragmatic upper bound on performance, acknowledging that theoretical hardware limits are rarely achieved in practice. It must be emphasized that this analysis provides an estimation of performance. While grounded in a rigorous model, the precise values of these ceilings can only be determined through exhaustive empirical micro-benchmarking on the physical hardware.
blocks.zh: 这种方法对性能产生了更保守和务实的上行约束,承认理论硬件限制在实践中很少实现. 必须强调,这一分析提供了业绩估计。 虽然以严格的模型为基础,但这些上限的精确值只能通过对物理硬件进行详尽的实证微标来确定。

blocks.en: The evaluation is conducted across a curated set of hardware platforms representative of the low-cost robotics domain. These include a standard Linux laptop, which serves as a baseline for development, the Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ 4 4 4 https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rpi3/raspberry-pi-3-b-plus-product-brief.pdf , selected for its ubiquity, and the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B 5 5 5 https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rpi4/raspberry-pi-4-datasheet.pdf and NVIDIA Jetson Nano 2 GB 6 6 6 https://cdn.sparkfun.com/assets/7/9/7/b/d/Jetson_Nano_2GB_datasheet.pdf , chosen for their widespread adoption. The key technical specifications for these platforms, compiled from official datasheets and verified sources, are summarized in Table 6 .

blocks.en: 4.9.1 Theoretical Complexity of the Proposed Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.9.1 拟议结构的理论复杂性

blocks.en: A bottom-up, hardware-agnostic analysis of the proposed architecture establishes a baseline of its computational and memory requirements. The complete pseudo-synthetic architecture consists of a convolutional encoder, a shared convolutional decoder, and a lightweight MLP classifier. The parameter counts for each component, as measured using the TensorFlow Keras framework, are as follows:
blocks.zh: 对拟议架构进行自下而上、硬件不可知的分析,确定了其计算和内存要求的基准。 完整的伪合成架构由一款相接编码器,一款相接的相接式相接解码器和一款轻量级的MLP分级器组成. 使用TensorFlow Keras框架测量的每个组件的参数计数如下:

blocks.en: For the inference phase, the decoder is not utilized. The deployed model consists only of the convolutional encoder and the MLP classifier. This results in an operational inference model with a total of 2176568 parameters ( i.e. , ∼ \sim 2.18 million).

blocks.en: The key metrics for our efficiency analysis are derived from this inference model. The memory footprint is calculated based on the parameter count, assuming standard 32-bit Floating-Point (FP32) precision, where each parameter occupies 4 bytes. Therefore, the model’s memory footprint corresponds to 8.31 MiB. The computational cost is measured in Floating-Point Operations (FLOPs), following the common convention that a Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) operation is equivalent to approximately 2 FLOPs. Based on the model’s layer-by-layer structure, we estimate its computational load for a single forward pass on a 64x64 RGB input image to be ∼ \sim 169.4 MFLOPs.
blocks.zh: 我们效率分析的关键衡量标准来自这一推论模型。 内存脚印根据参数数来计算,假设标准32位浮点(FP32)精度,每个参数占据了4字节. 因此,模型的记忆足迹对应8.31 MiB. 计算成本以浮点操作法(FLOPs)来计量,因为通用惯例是多相累积操作法(MAC)相当于约2个FLOP. 基于模型的逐层结构,我们估计它的计算载荷,一个64x64的RGB输入图像的单个前传为\\sim 169.4 MFLOPs.

blocks.en: The analysis presented in Table 7 confirms the suitability of our proposed policy for deployment in low-cost robotics for real-time, reactive visual navigation. The model’s low memory footprint and modest computational load are well within the capabilities of modern embedded systems.
blocks.zh: 表7提供的分析证实,我们拟议的政策适用于部署在低成本机器人上进行实时、被动的视觉导航。 该模型的内存足迹低和计算负荷小,完全在现代嵌入式系统的能力范围内.

blocks.en: The Linux laptop serves as a strong baseline, indicating that development and testing can be performed with extremely high throughput. The Raspberry Pi 3B+, however, is shown to be a challenging platform. Our realistic estimate of ∼ \sim 4 FPS falls below the typical 30-60 FPS range considered sufficient for smooth navigation, suggesting this hardware is unsuitable for the task without a dedicated accelerator.
blocks.zh: Linux膝上型电脑是一个很强的基线,表明开发和测试可以在极高的吞吐量下进行. 然而,Raspberry Pi 3B+被证明是一个具有挑战性的平台. 我们实际估计的 \\ sim 4 FPS 低于被认为足以平稳导航的典型的 30-60 FPS 范围,说明这个硬件不适合没有专用加速器的任务.

blocks.en: This estimation aligns with the findings of Feng et al. [ 65 ], who measured an inference time of 117.7 ms ( i.e. , ∼ \sim 8.5 FPS) for their VAE-based model, which relies on 2.2 million parameters, on the same hardware. Given our inference model has a very similar parameter count, both results confirm that this class of deep learning model is too demanding for the Raspberry Pi 3B+ alone.
blocks.zh: 这一估计与冯等[65]的结论一致,冯等测出其基于VAE的模型的推论时间为117.7 ms(即-\sim 8.5 FPS),该模型依赖于220万个参数,基于相同的硬件. 鉴于我们的推论模型有一个非常相近的参数计数,这两个结果都证实,这一类深层学习模型对于Raspberry Pi 3B+来说要求太高了.

blocks.en: In contrast, the Raspberry Pi 4B emerges as a highly viable platform. Its estimated performance of ∼ \sim 46 FPS comfortably falls within the 30-60 FPS range required for real-time applications, enabling smooth and reactive control. This result confirms that the generational leap in performance from the Raspberry Pi 3B+ is sufficient to make it a primary candidate for deploying our navigation policy.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,Raspberry Pi 4B作为一个非常可行的平台出现. 其估计性能为 \\ sim 46 FPS 舒适地属于实时应用所需的30-60 FPS范围,能够进行平稳和被动的控制. 这一结果证实,Raspberry Pi 3B+的代际性能飞跃,足以使它成为部署我国通航政策的主要候选者。

blocks.en: The NVIDIA Jetson Nano 2 GB provides exceptional performance, with an estimated throughput of ∼ \sim 833 FPS. Even when accounting for significant system overheads that would reduce this number in practice, the performance is far beyond the requirements of reactive navigation. This computational margin makes it suitable for running more complex tasks in parallel, such as mapping or object recognition.
blocks.zh: NVIDIA 杰森纳诺 2 GB提供特异性能,估计吞吐量为 \\ sim 833 FPS. 即使计算出在实践中会减少这一数目的重大系统间接费用,这种性能也远远超出了被动导航的要求。 这种计算比值使其适合并行运行更复杂的任务,如映射或对象识别.

blocks.en: To further contextualize these results, we compare them with the work of Falaschetti et al. [ 63 ], who evaluated a compressed Tiny You-Only-Look-Once (YOLO) v3 variant for vehicle and pedestrian detection. Their final model has a slightly lower parameter count of ∼ \sim 1.92 million but a significantly higher computational load: 948 MFLOPs. Furthermore, it operates on larger 416x416 images.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步结合这些结果,我们将它们与Falaschetti等人[63]的工作进行比较,他们评价了一个压缩的Tiny You-Once(YOLO)v3变体,用于车辆和行人检测. 其最终模型的参数计数略低,为\\sim 192万个,但计算负载明显高:948个MFLOP. 此外,它还使用更大的416x416图像。

blocks.en: On the Jetson Nano 2 GB, Falaschetti et al. ’s model achieved an empirical 36.46 FPS. Our model is estimated to be substantially faster primarily due to two intentional design trade-offs: a much lower computational load and a significantly smaller input image resolution of 64x64. This highlights a key principle for vision-based robotics: by focusing the network on learning from compressed, low-dimensional representations tailored to the navigation task, the computational burden of the policy can be dramatically reduced compared to more general-purpose object detection architectures. This makes our approach particularly well-suited for the target application domain of real-time reactive navigation on resource-constrained hardware.
blocks.zh: 在Jetson Nano 2 GB上, Falaschetti 等. 其模式实现了经验性36.46 FPS. 我们的模型估计要快得多,主要是因为两个有意的设计取舍:计算负荷要低得多,输入图像分辨率要小得多64x64。 这凸显了基于视觉的机器人学的一个关键原则:通过将网络的重点放在从适合导航任务的压缩低维表现中学习,与更通用的物体检测架构相比,可以大幅度地减轻政策的计算负担. 这使得我们的方法特别适合资源受限硬件上实时被动导航的目标应用领域.

blocks.en: 4.10 Case Study: Real-World Deployment for Reactive Collision-Free Exploration
blocks.zh: 4.10 (中文(简体) ). 案例研究:实时部署以进行无反应碰撞勘探

blocks.en: To empirically validate the practical applicability and real-time performance of our proposed transfer learning method, we deployed the learned image classification policy on a physical robotic platform. This subsection details the experimental configuration and demonstrates that our pseudo-synthetic policy, developed through a hybrid strategy of domain randomization and domain adaptation, effectively translates into a robust, reactive navigation behavior capable of performing indoor exploration tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了从经验上验证我们提议的转移学习方法的实际适用性和实时性能,我们在物理机器人平台上运用了学到的图像分类政策. 本分节详细介绍了实验配置,并表明我们通过域随机化和域相适应的混合策略所制定的伪合成政策,有效地转化为能够执行室内探索任务的强健而被动的导航行为.

blocks.en: 4.10.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.10.1 实验设置

blocks.en: The primary goal of this case study was to validate the navigational competence of the proposed policy, separating its effectiveness from hardware performance limitations. The only embedded platform available for deployment was the Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+, for which our efficiency analysis in Subsection 4.9 estimated a throughput of merely ∼ \sim 4 FPS. This performance level is insufficient for the demands of real-time reactive navigation. Given that more powerful embedded platforms, such as the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B or NVIDIA Jetson Nano 2 GB, and compatible hardware accelerators were not available, a direct deployment on the Raspberry Pi 3B+ was deemed infeasible.
blocks.zh: 本案例研究的主要目的是验证拟议政策的导航能力,将其效力同硬件性能限制区分开来。 唯一可供部署的嵌入式平台是Raspberry Pi 3 型号B+,我们在第4.9分节中的效率分析估计,其吞吐量仅为\\ sim 4 FPS。 这一性能水平不足以满足实时被动导航的需求. 鉴于更强大的嵌入式平台,如Raspberry Pi 4 Model B或NVIDIA Jetson Nano 2 GB,相容的硬件加速器无法提供,在Raspberry Pi 3B+上直接部署被认为是不可行的.

blocks.en: Consequently, we adopted a distributed architecture that leverages our Linux laptop as the primary computational node for high-level inference. This decision directly links our computational analysis to our empirical validation, demonstrating a practical methodology for testing complex policies when target hardware is constrained. As predicted by the analysis in Subsection 4.9 , the laptop’s processing power was more than sufficient to execute the inference model in real-time.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们采用了一种分布式结构,利用我们的Linux笔记本电脑作为高级推论的主要计算节点。 这一决定将我们的计算分析与我们的经验验证直接联系起来,展示了在目标硬件受限时测试复杂政策的实用方法. 正如第4.9分节的分析所预测的,膝上型计算机的处理功率足以实时执行推论模型.

blocks.en: The core of this validation involved transferring the pseudo-synthetic deep neural network architecture to the physical robot to perform an autonomous, map-less exploration of the real indoor corridor. blocks.en: 4.10.4 Robustness to Environmental Variations
blocks.zh: 4.10.4 环境变化的强度

blocks.en: To further assess the generalization and adaptation capabilities of the proposed policy, we conducted a qualitative comparison of the system’s performance on two different days, under varying lighting conditions and with the presence of novel elements not seen during training. As shown in Fig. 13 , our autonomous navigation policy, depicted in the right column of each panel, consistently produced coherent and safe actions that mirrored an expert-demonstrated ( i.e. , teleoperated by a human expert) behavior. The latter is represented in the left column of each panel.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 13 (a), our navigation system demonstrated robustness to environmental variations, such as changes in ambient light, the presence or absence of certain objects ( e.g. , the blue adhesive sign on the floor), and the appearance of a person, correctly predicting forward commands in open spaces. These commands encourage greater exploration of the environment.
blocks.zh: 如图13(a)所示,我国的导航系统显示出环境变化的坚固性,例如环境光的变化、某些物体的存在或缺失(例如地上蓝色粘合标志),以及一个人的外表,正确预测了在开放空间中的前进指令。 这些指令鼓励对环境进行更深入的探索.

blocks.en: Most notably, the proposed policy exhibited intelligent reactivity. For example, in the last scenario of Fig. 13 (b), which is analogous to a case in Fig. 6 (b), the ground-truth label from the expert corresponded to a right turn, but our policy predicted a left turn. This decision was still correct in a reactive context, as the crucial action was to turn and avoid the imminent obstacle, not to replicate the exact direction. This behavior, inspired by biological stress reactions, prioritizes immediate safety over exact imitation, a key feature for robust embodied navigation in the real world.
blocks.zh: 最值得注意的是,拟议的政策表现出明智的反应。 例如,在图13(b)的上个情景中(这与图6(b)中的一例类似),专家的地真相标签对应于右转,但我们的政策预测是左转。 在被动背景下,这一决定仍然是正确的,因为关键的行动是扭转并避免迫在眉睫的障碍,而不是重复确切的方向。 这种行为受生物应激反应所启发,将即时安全置于绝对模仿之上,这是真实世界中强健地体现通航的关键特征.

blocks.en: Finally, as depicted in Fig. 13 (c), the policy proved adaptable to dynamic events, correctly issuing stop commands when a person’s hand or feet suddenly entered the camera’s field of view, thus preventing collisions in dynamic situations. This comprehensive real-world validation confirms that our hybrid transfer learning approach produces policies that are not only accurate but also effective, robust, and flexible when deployed on low-cost physical robots in challenging indoor scenarios.
blocks.zh: 最后,如图13(c)所描述的,事实证明这项政策能够适应动态事件,在一个人的手或脚突然进入相机视场时正确发出停止命令,从而防止了动态情况下的相撞。 这一全面的现实世界验证证实,我们的混合转移学习方法所产生的政策不仅准确,而且有效、有力和灵活,在挑战性室内情景中部署在低成本物理机器人上。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: This study has presented and validated a hybrid transfer learning method designed for vision-based robotic navigation, which enables the efficient training of classification policies using primarily simulated data supplemented with limited real-world examples. The core of our approach is a dual convolutional variational autoencoder architecture with a shared decoder, which integrates domain randomization with a subsequent, refined domain adaptation stage.
blocks.zh: 这项研究提出并验证了一种基于视觉的机器人导航的混合转移学习方法,该方法主要利用模拟数据进行分类政策的有效培训,辅之以有限的现实世界实例。 我们方法的核心是双旋变异自编码器架构,并配有共享的解码器,将域随机化与后续的精细域适应阶段相融合.

blocks.en: The contributions of this work fulfill a dual objective: first, we validated the practical efficacy of the proposed policy through a proof-of-concept deployment on a low-cost physical robot performing a reactive, collision-free exploration task. Second, we provided a rigorous estimation of the model’s computational performance, confirming its suitability for deployment on resource-constrained embedded platforms.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的贡献实现了一个双重目标:第一,我们通过在低成本的物理机器人上部署概念证明,验证了拟议政策的实际效力,该机器人执行的是一种反应性、无相撞的探索任务。 第二,我们严格估计了模型的计算性能,确认其适合部署在受资源限制的嵌入式平台上。

blocks.en: Our comprehensive experimental results substantiate our three foundational hypotheses:
blocks.zh: 我们的全面实验结果证实了我们三个基本假设:

blocks.en: 1. Training a policy exclusively with a small real-world dataset is insufficient for achieving robust performance in autonomous navigation tasks. This real-only approach yielded an average success rate of approximately 70% on unseen real-world data, a limitation that stems from the inherent difficulties in acquiring extensive and balanced labeled datasets from real-world environments. 2. A policy trained solely on an extensive synthetic dataset via domain randomization exhibits limited real-world generalization, failing to surpass a 41% average success rate on real test images. This finding underscores that systematic discrepancies between simulation and reality persist even when using a high-fidelity simulator, making direct sim-to-real transfer unreliable. 3. Our proposed hybrid transfer learning method significantly improves predictive capacity, achieving an average success rate of nearly 91% on unseen real-world data. This is accomplished by first leveraging domain randomization and subsequently performing feature-level domain adaptation, a process initiated with a small set of real images and enhanced via two complementary data augmentation techniques. The dual VAE architecture, with its shared decoder, effectively forces the alignment of feature distributions, thereby bridging the simulation-to-reality domain gap.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 仅用一个小的实时数据组来培训一项政策,不足以在自主导航任务中取得强劲的业绩。 这种仅以现实为主的方法在无形的现实世界数据上取得了约70%的平均成功率,这一限制源于在从现实世界环境中获取广泛和平衡的有标签的数据集方面固有的困难。 2. 一项仅通过域随机化进行广泛合成数据集培训的政策显示,现实世界的通用程度有限,未能超过实际测试图像的平均成功率41%。 这一结论突出表明,即使使用高真实度模拟器,模拟与现实之间的系统性差异依然存在,使直接的模拟到实际转移不可靠。 3. 我们提议的混合转移学习方法大大提高了预测能力,在无形的实际情况中,平均成功率接近91%。 这是通过首先利用域随机化,然后进行地物级域的适应来实现的,这个过程是用一小组真实图像启动的,并通过两种互补的数据增强技术得到增强. 具有共享解码器的双相VAE架构有效地迫使特征分布的对接,从而弥补了模拟到真实域的差距.

blocks.en: Building on these findings, our future research will proceed along three primary directions. Foremost, we will conduct an empirical validation of the computational performance estimations presented in Subsection 4.9 . This will involve deploying and benchmarking the inference model on the target low-cost hardware, including the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B and the NVIDIA Jetson Nano 2 GB, to obtain precise latency and throughput metrics.
blocks.zh: 在这些结论的基础上,我们今后的研究将沿着三个主要方向进行。 首先,我们将对4.9分节提出的计算性能估计进行实证验证。 这将涉及部署针对目标低成本硬件的推论模型并设定基准,包括Raspberry Pi 4模型B和NVIDIA Jetson Nano 2 GB,以获得精确的延迟度和通量度。

blocks.en: Second, we intend to expand the real-world evaluation phase by subjecting the navigation policy to more complex and dynamic indoor environments. These experiments will assess the policy’s robustness against greater environmental variations, including significant changes in illumination, higher levels of clutter, and the presence of dynamic obstacles.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们打算扩大现实世界评价阶段,使导航政策适应更复杂和更具活力的室内环境。 这些实验将评估该政策的稳健性,以对付更大的环境变化,包括照明的重大变化、更高的杂乱程度和动态障碍的存在。

blocks.en: Finally, we plan to extend the framework to swarm robotics [ 67 ] platforms. This involves deploying our VAE-based perception model across multiple low-cost agents, enabling decentralized, real-time visual processing for collaborative navigation tasks such as coordinated exploration, target tracking, and surveillance in large-scale, complex real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们计划将框架扩大到群机器人[67]平台。 这涉及将我们的基于VAE的感知模型用于多种低成本剂剂,使分散的实时视觉处理能够用于协作导航任务,如协调探索、目标跟踪和大规模复杂的现实世界情景中的监视。
